Sie sind Hersteller oder Betreiber von Maschinen und Anlagen?
Dann betrifft Sie die neue Maschinenverordnung (EU) 2023/1230 direkt.
Pflichtwissen für Hersteller, Betreiber und Inverkehrbringer. Was sich ändert, was bis 20.01.2027 zu tun ist – und wie Sie Lieferanten, Dokumentation und CE-Prozesse wirklich im Griff behalten.
Hierbei lernen Sie:
Welche neuen Pflichten auf Sie zukommen,
worauf Sie bei Lieferanten und Einbauteilen achten müssen,
wie Sie weiterhin rechtssicher CE-Kennzeichnungen und Risikobeurteilungen erstellen und
wie Sie sich jetzt optimal vorbereiten, um 2027 konform zu sein.

Für wen ist das Webinar?
Für Hersteller, Betreiber, Inverkehrbringer und Integratoren von Maschinen/Anlagen, die
die Maschinenverordnung (EU) 2023/1230 korrekt anwenden,
Lieferanten rechtssicher einbinden,
und CE-Kennzeichnung & Risikobeurteilung (EN ISO 12100) effizient aufsetzen wollen.
[/vc_column_text][vc_separator][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_cta h2="🛠️ Häufige Fragen von unseren Kunden zur neuen Maschinenverordnung (EU) 2023/1230" h4="Die Maschinenverordnung (EU) 2023/1230 gilt ab 20.01.2027 verbindlich. Hier findest du klare Antworten zu Pflichten, CE-Kennzeichnung, KI/Cybersecurity, digitalen Anleitungen und Übergangsregeln. (Stand: 19.08.2025)"][/vc_cta][vc_separator][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_toggle title="Was ist die Maschinenverordnung (EU) 2023/1230?" el_id="faq-was-ist-die-maschinenverordnung-eu-2023-1230"]
Kurzantwort: Neue, direkt geltende EU-Verordnung, die die Maschinenrichtlinie 2006/42/EG ablöst; verbindlich ab 20.01.2027.Details:
Gilt unmittelbar in allen EU-Staaten (keine nationale Umsetzung nötig).
Hebt Sicherheitsniveau an; umfasst KI, Software und Cybersecurity.
Erlaubt digitale Betriebsanleitungen (mit Pflicht zur Printversion auf Wunsch).
[/vc_toggle][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_toggle title="Ab wann gilt die neue Maschinenverordnung verbindlich?" el_id="faq-ab-wann-gilt-die-maschinenverordnung-verbindlich"]
Kurzantwort: Ab 20.01.2027 müssen betroffene Wirtschaftsakteure die neuen Vorgaben einhalten.Details:
Übergangszeit bis 20.01.2027 zur Anpassung von Technik & Dokumentation.
Frühzeitig starten, um Engpässe bei Benannten Stellen zu vermeiden.
[/vc_toggle][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_toggle title="Was droht bei Verstößen?" el_id="faq-was-droht-bei-verstoessen"]Kurzantwort: Rückrufe, Verkaufsverbote, Bußgelder, ggf. strafrechtliche Folgen und Haftung für Personen-/Sachschäden.
Daher prüfen Sie frühzeitig, wie Sie davon betroffen sind und nutzen Sie die Gelegenheit, frühzeitig entgegen zu wirken.[/vc_toggle][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_toggle title="Welche Produkte sind betroffen?" el_id="faq-welche-produkte-sind-betroffen"]
urzantwort: Maschinen, unvollständige Maschinen, Sicherheitsbauteile und austauschbare Ausrüstungen, die in der EU in Verkehr gebracht/in Betrieb genommen werden.Details:
Beispiele: Roboterzellen, Förderanlagen, Schutzeinrichtungen (z. B. Lichtschranken).
Auch Software-Aspekte, die Sicherheitsfunktionen beeinflussen.
[/vc_toggle][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_toggle title="Was sind „unvollständige Maschinen“?" el_id="faq-was-sind-unvollstaendige-maschinen"]
Kurzantwort: Baugruppen ohne volle Schutzfunktionen; nicht eigenständig sicher betreibbar.Details:
Einbauerklärung erforderlich, keine CE-Kennzeichnung.
Beispiel: Roboterarm ohne Steuerung/Umhausung für Integration in Anlage.
[/vc_toggle][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_toggle title="Was ändert sich gegenüber der Maschinenrichtlinie 2006/42/EG?" el_id="faq-was-aendert-sich-gegenueber-der-maschinenrichtlinie-2006-42-eg"]
Kurzantwort: Mehr Digital-/Software-Pflichten, Cybersecurity, KI-Regeln, digitale Anleitungen und klare Rollen für Hersteller/Importeure/Händler.Details:
Neue Kategorie hochriskanter/„besonders gefährlicher“ Maschinen mit strengeren Verfahren.
Digitale Anleitung zulässig; gedruckt auf Wunsch kostenlos bereitzustellen.
[/vc_toggle][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_toggle title="Was sind „besonders gefährliche Maschinen“?" el_id="faq-was-sind-besonders-gefaehrliche-maschinen"]
Kurzantwort: Hochrisiko-Maschinen (z. B. Sägen, Pressen, autonome Systeme mit KI), die verpflichtend von einer Benannten Stelle bewertet werden.Details:
Strengeres Konformitätsbewertungsverfahren.
Liste der betroffenen Typen ist festgelegt (prüfe gegen deine Produktfamilien).
[/vc_toggle][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_toggle title="Ist die CE-Kennzeichnung weiterhin Pflicht?" el_id="faq-ist-die-ce-kennzeichnung-weiterhin-pflicht"]
Kurzantwort: Ja. Ohne gültige CE-Kennzeichnung kein Verkauf und keine Inbetriebnahme.Details:
CE bestätigt Konformität mit den grundlegenden Sicherheits-/Gesundheitsanforderungen.
Technische Doku, Risikobeurteilung und Konformitätserklärung bleiben zentral.
[/vc_toggle][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_toggle title="Darf ich Betriebsanleitungen digital bereitstellen?" el_id="faq-sind-digitale-betriebsanleitungen-erlaubt-a"]
Kurzantwort: Ja, digital (PDF/Online) ist erlaubt; Printversion muss auf Wunsch kostenlos bereitgestellt werden.Details:
Stelle Zugänglichkeit/Verfügbarkeit über den Lebenszyklus sicher.
Versionierung/Änderungsdienst regeln (QR-Code/Link in der Maschine empfohlen).
[/vc_toggle][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_toggle title="Gibt es Übergangsregelungen?" el_id="faq-gibt-es-uebergangsregelungen-a"]
Kurzantwort: Ja. Konform nach 2006/42/EG in Verkehr gebrachte Maschinen dürfen nach dem 20.01.2027 weiter verkauft/betrieben werden, wenn rechtzeitig in Verkehr gebracht.Details:
Bestehende Doku/Kennzeichnung bleiben für diese Produkte gültig.
Änderungen/Upgrades können erneute Bewertung auslösen.

### CE-CON LOTO
[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" css=".vc_custom_1747653275948{background-image: url(https://www.ce-con.de/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/loto_lock_out_tag_out_3_4.jpg?id=1538) !important;background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}" el_id="head"][vc_column width="7/12"][/vc_column][vc_column width="5/12" css=".vc_custom_1702370291798{padding-top: 10px !important;padding-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_custom_heading text="Software
CE-CON LOTO" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1747910434834{padding-top: 100px !important;padding-bottom: 100px !important;padding-left: 30px !important;background-color: #ffffff !important;}"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row" content_placement="middle" top_padding="60px" bottom_padding="60px" css=".vc_custom_1650303913826{background-color: #eeeeee !important;}"][vc_column][vc_column_text]
Create and manage lockout/tagout procedures efficiently - with CE-CON LOTO
Occupational safety during maintenance is not a nice-to-have - it is a legal obligation. A key component of this is a lockout/tagout program with clear procedures.
Lockout/tagout (LOTO) originally comes from the USA and is described there in the OSHA standard 21 CFR 1910.147. In Germany, Section 10 (3) of the Betriebssicherheitsverordnung regulates safety during maintenance measures. And with LOTO you can optimally implement the so-called 1st rank in accordance with the proven 4-rank method: The energy supply is interrupted and unauthorized, erroneous or unexpected start-up is ruled out.
CE-CON LOTO is the cloud-based software solution for health and safety officers and maintenance engineers that allows you to plan, implement and permanently document LOTO procedures in a standardized way - simply, safely and traceably.

Lockout/Tagout-Prozeduren effizient erstellen und verwalten – mit CE-CON LOTO
Arbeitssicherheit bei Instandhaltungen ist kein Nice-to-have – sie ist gesetzliche Pflicht. Ein zentraler Baustein dafür ist ein Lockout/Tagout-Programm mit klaren Prozeduren.
Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) stammt ursprünglich aus den USA und ist dort im OSHA-Standard 21 CFR 1910.147 beschrieben. In Deutschland regelt § 10 Absatz 3 der Betriebssicherheitsverordnung die Sicherheit bei Instandhaltungsmaßnahmen. Und mit LOTO können Sie den sogenannten 1. Rang gemäß der bewährten 4-Rang-Methode optimal umsetzen: Die Energieversorgung wird unterbrochen und ein unbefugtes, irrtümliches oder unerwartetes Ingangsetzen ausgeschlossen.
CE-CON LOTO ist die cloudbasierte Softwarelösung für Arbeitsschützer und Instandhalter, mit der Sie LOTO-Prozeduren standardisiert planen, umsetzen und dauerhaft dokumentieren – einfach, sicher und nachvollziehbar.

Functions of the CE-CON Safety software
Our CE-CON Safety software offers you a wide range of functions. In the test version, in our webinars or in a personal appointment, you can get to know the full range of these functions.[/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]
Working in the cloud
[/vc_column_text][vc_toggle title="Cloud-based"]Cloud-based means that the software and IT infrastructure are operated by an IT service provider on a secure server in Germany and can be used by you as a customer as a service. This approach means that it is not necessary to install and run the applications on your own computers or in your own data centers. There are no additional costs for the purchase, provision and maintenance of hardware or installation. All you need is an internet-enabled computer or tablet and a permanent internet connection. The software can then be accessed via any standard web browser.[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Data protection and data security"]Safety is a top priority at CE-CON. CE-CON Safety is operated in a data center in Bremen. This offers a power supply and cooling system secured by emergency diesel generators. The data center is redundantly connected to the fiber optic network and is monitored 24/7. Data is transferred between the end user and the data center using encrypted data transmission (SSL/TLS). The backups carried out in the data center are physically stored securely in separate areas.[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Automatic updates"]The software is constantly being developed and updated. There are no additional maintenance contracts or other costs for CE-CON Safety. You will receive a notification on your dashboard within the software informing you of the update and showing you the changes.
You can easily send us your own ideas and suggestions for improvement via our support portal.[/vc_toggle][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1745508546851{padding-top: 20px !important;}"]
Work efficiently
[/vc_column_text][vc_toggle title="Template management"]Templates can minimize the time needed to create and edit risk assessments and provide a company-wide standard.
You have the option of saving information as a template and reusing it across projects:
 	Text modules (particularly suitable for continuous texts)
 	Danger points
 	Protection concepts/templates for measures including a combination of several measures
 	Phases of life with activity descriptions
 	Entire machine components
Complete products or project templates can simply be used as copy templates. When copying, you then selectively decide which components are to be transferred to the new project.
Template management really comes into its own in series production: recurring machine types or system variants can be documented efficiently and consistently. The reuse of existing templates - e.g. for protective measures, danger points or complete components - significantly reduces the effort required for new projects. At the same time, standardization ensures uniform documentation and reduces sources of error in the CE process. But even in classic special machine construction, electrical hazards and technical requirements for pneumatics or hydraulics occur again and again to the same extent.
By using templates, you not only save time and resources, but also create a solid basis for standard-compliant risk assessments with consistent quality - regardless of how many variants or series you need to map.[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="File management and document management"]CE-CON Safety helps you to save all project-related information in one place. This can be layouts, photos, data sheets, circuit diagrams and any other files.
Verification documentation for calculations, test reports or supplier declarations will find the right place.
Instead of describing a safety fence and access concept, simply upload the corresponding safety layout.
You can invite your suppliers via the rights management and activate them for the project. Have your suppliers and service providers upload the necessary information directly to CE-CON Safety and save yourself unnecessary work.
And if things get tricky, you can have one of our experts take a look at your assessment at any time.[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Document generation"]With CE-CON Safety, you can generate all the documents required for CE marking with predefined templates (depending on the project type), for example:
 	Risk assessment / Partial risk assessments
 	Declaration of Conformity / Declaration of Incorporation
 	List of essential health and safety requirements
 	References of harmonized standards
 	Safety considerations
 	Checklists
 	Information for the operating instructions
By uploading your stationery (cover sheet, background), you can adapt the design of the documents to your company's own layout.
Tip: Would you like more company-specific documents? Please contact us.[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="PDF/A-1"]Our cloud-based software supports output in PDF/A-1 format, the international standard for long-term archiving of digital documents. This ensures that your technical documentation, risk analyses and legally relevant evidence remain stored unchanged and legally compliant in the long term - in accordance with the requirements of the Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC and EN ISO 12100. Thanks to embedded fonts, consistent formatting and validated metadata, your CE documentation is not only archivable, but also traceable and audit-proof at all times.[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Change history"]All changes made to a project can be viewed via the change history. This creates complete project documentation. The change history can only be viewed by administrators.
Versioning is therefore not necessary during the editing phase, but can of course be entered for the storage documentation.[/vc_toggle][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]
Working in compliance with the law
[/vc_column_text][vc_toggle title="Risk assessment"]Risk assessment is a key process for ensuring the safety of products. For machinery, this is carried out in accordance with EN ISO 12100. There is a similar procedure for electrical equipment in accordance with CENELEC Guide 32, and the GPSR has also stipulated a risk analysis since 2024.
CE-CON Safety supports you in a structured and seamless implementation and automatically in complying with the three-step procedure.
As EN ISO 12100 is applicable worldwide as an ISO standard, CE-CON Safety is also suitable for machines that are placed on the market outside the EU.[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Harmonization legislation and standards"]CE harmonization legislation, standards and other information crucial to product safety are constantly changing. For this reason, CE-CON Safety is constantly kept up to date by checking the database for new developments several times a month and automatically updating it in the software. For example, the database contains around 9000 data records for the harmonized standards published in the EU.
And, of course, the transition from the Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC to the new Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 is also fully supported.[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Compliance Manager"]The CE conformity assessment procedure does not only consist of a risk assessment! The CE regulations place many more requirements on compliant products.
In the Compliance Manager, you will find project type-dependent checklists and smart wizards that are relevant to your project:
 	Essantial health and safety requirements
 	Technical documentation for machinery
 	Requirements of the various conformity assessment modules
 	After-market obligations
 	Information on the labeling of products
With CE-CON Safety you can therefore cover the entire CE process.[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Pivot points for product compliance"]With CE-CON Safety, you always have an overview of whether you have already completely fulfilled the requirements for your product or whether tasks are still open or certain areas still need to be worked on.
CE-CON Safety also supports the work of technical writers, designers and those who have to validate measures in the context of functional safety by providing selected lists, e.g. with
 	Control measures with performance level
 	List of pictograms to be used
 	List of user information to be included in the operating/assembly instructions
You can edit these checklists via a mobile device or in paper form directly on the product or machine and mark them as tested.
Customized checklists can be configured and stored for you.[/vc_toggle][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1745508551041{padding-top: 20px !important;}"]

Funktionsumfang der Software CE-CON Safety
Unsere Software CE-CON Safety bietet Ihnen eine Vielzahl von Funktionen. In der Cloud arbeiten
[/vc_column_text][vc_toggle title="Cloudbasiert"]
Cloudbasiert heißt, dass die Software und die IT-Infrastruktur bei einem IT-Dienstleister auf einem sicheren Server in Deutschland betrieben und von Ihnen als Kunde als Dienstleistung genutzt werden kann. Durch dieses Vorgehen ist es nicht nötig, die Anwendungen auf Ihren eigenen Computern oder in Ihren eigenen Rechenzentren zu installieren und auszuführen. Es entstehen keine zusätzlichen Kosten für die Anschaffung, Bereitstellung und Wartung von Hardware oder die Installation. Für die Nutzung wird lediglich ein internetfähiger Computer oder ein Tablet, sowie die permanente Internetverbindung benötigt. Der Zugriff auf die Software erfolgt dann über jeden gängigen Webbrowser.
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Datenschutz- und Datensicherheit"]Sicherheit wird im Hause CE-CON großgeschrieben. CE-CON Safety wird in einem Rechenzentrum in Bremen betrieben. Dieses bietet eine durch Notstromdiesel abgesicherte Energieversorgung und Kühlung. Das Rechenzentrum ist redundant ans Glasfasernetz angeschlossen und wird 24/7 überwacht. Die Datenübertragung zwischen dem Endanwender und dem Rechenzentrum findet mittels verschlüsselter Datenübertragung (SSL/TLS) statt. Die im Rechenzentrum durchgeführten Backups werden physikalisch voneinander in getrennten Bereichen sicher aufbewahrt.[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Automatische Updates"]Die Software wird stetig weiterentwickelt und aktualisiert. Für CE-CON Safety entstehen keine zusätzlichen Wartungsverträge oder andere Kosten. Sie erhalten innerhalb der Software eine Information auf Ihrem Dashboard, die Sie über das Update informiert und Ihnen die Änderungen anzeigt.
Eigene Ideen und Verbesserungsvorschläge können Sie uns über unser Support-Portal ganz einfach mitteilen.[/vc_toggle][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1744634639045{padding-top: 20px !important;}"]
Effizient arbeiten
[/vc_column_text][vc_toggle title="Vorlagenverwaltung"]Durch Vorlagen kann die Zeit zum Erstellen und Bearbeiten von Risikobeurteilungen auf ein Minimum reduziert werden und ein unternehmensweiter Standard zur Verfügung gestellt werden.
Sie haben die Möglichkeit Informationen als Vorlage zu speichern und projektübergreifend wieder zu verwenden:
 	Textbausteine (besonders für Fließtexte geeignet)
 	Gefahrenstellen
 	Schutzkonzepte/Maßnahmenvorlagen inkl. einer Kombination von mehreren Maßnahmen
 	Lebensphasen mit Tätigkeitsbeschreibungen
 	Ganze Maschinenkomponenten
Komplette Produkte oder Projektvorlagen können einfach als Kopiervorlage genutzt werden. Hier entscheiden Sie dann beim Kopieren selektiv, welche Baugruppen in das neue Projekt übernommen werden sollen.
Gerade in der Serienfertigung entfaltet die Vorlagenverwaltung ihr volles Potenzial: Wiederkehrende Maschinentypen oder Anlagenvarianten lassen sich effizient und konsistent dokumentieren. Durch die Wiederverwendung vorhandener Vorlagen – z. B. für Schutzmaßnahmen, Gefahrenstellen oder komplette Baugruppen – wird der Aufwand für neue Projekte erheblich reduziert. Gleichzeitig sorgt die Standardisierung für eine einheitliche Dokumentation und reduziert Fehlerquellen im CE-Prozess. Aber auch im klassischen Sondermaschinenbau kommen elektrische Gefahren, technische Anforderungen an Pneumatik oder Hydraulik immer wieder im selben Umfang vor.
Durch die Verwendung von Vorlagen sparen Sie so nicht nur Zeit und Ressourcen, sondern schaffen auch eine solide Basis für normkonforme Risikobeurteilungen bei gleichbleibender Qualität – unabhängig davon, wie viele Varianten oder Serien Sie abbilden müssen.[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Dateiverwaltung und Dokumentenverwaltung"]
CE-CON Safety unterstützt Sie dabei, alle projektbezogenen Informationen an einem Ort zu sichern. Dies können Layout, Fotos, Datenblätter, Schaltpläne und beliebige weitere Dateien sein.
Nachweisdokumentationen für Berechnungen, Testberichte oder Zuliefererklärungen finden so Ihren richtigen Ort.
Statt eine Schutzzaun und Zugangskonzept zu beschreiben, laden Sie einfach das entsprechende Sicherheitslayout hoch.
Sie können Ihren Lieferanten über die Rechteverwaltung einladen und für das Projekt freischalten. Lassen Sie notwendige Informationen von Ihren Lieferanten und Dienstleistern direkt in CE-CON Safety hochladen und ersparen Sie sich damit unnötige Arbeit.
Und sollte es mal knifflig werden, können Sie jederzeit einen unserer Experten einen Blick auf Ihre Beurteilung werfen lassen.
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Dokumentengenerierung"]Mit CE-CON Safety können Sie alle für die CE-Kennzeichnung benötigten Dokumente mit bereits vordefinierten Vorlagen (abhängig vom Projekttyp) erzeugen, zum Beispiel:
 	Risikobeurteilung / Teil-Risikobeurteilungen
 	Konformitätserklärung /Einbauerklärung
 	Liste der grundlegenden Sicherheits- und Gesundheitsschutzanforderungen
 	Referenzen der harmonisierten Normen
 	Sicherheitstechnische Betrachtungen
 	Prüflisten
 	Information für die Betriebsanleitung
Durch das Hochladen Ihres Briefpapiers (Deckblatt, Hintergrund) können Sie das Design der Dokumente an Ihr firmeneigenes Layout anpassen.
Tipp: Sie hätten gern noch weitere, unternehmensspezifische Dokumente? Sprechen Sie uns an.[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="PDF/A-1"]Unsere cloudbasierte Software unterstützt dabei die Ausgabe im PDF/A-1-Format, dem internationalen Standard für die Langzeitarchivierung digitaler Dokumente. So stellen Sie sicher, dass Ihre technische Dokumentation, Gefährdungsanalysen und rechtlich relevanten Nachweise auch langfristig unverändert und rechtssicher gespeichert bleiben – im Einklang mit den Anforderungen der Maschinenrichtlinie 2006/42/EG sowie der EN ISO 12100. Dank eingebetteter Schriftarten, konsistenter Formatierung und validierter Metadaten ist Ihre CE-Dokumentation nicht nur archivierungsfähig, sondern auch jederzeit nachvollziehbar und revisionssicher.[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Änderungshistorie"]Über die Änderungshistorie können alle vorgenommenen Veränderungen an einem Projekt eingesehen werden. So entsteht eine lückenlose Projektdokumentation. Die Änderungshistorie kann nur von Administratoren eingesehen werden.
Versionierungen sind somit während der Bearbeitungsphase nicht notwendig, können aber natürlich für die Ablagedokumentation eingetragen werden.[/vc_toggle][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]
Rechtskonform arbeiten
[/vc_column_text][vc_toggle title="Risikobeurteilung"]Die Risikobeurteilung ist ein zentraler Prozess, um die Sicherheit von Produkten zu gewährleisten. Für Maschinen wird diese entsprechend der EN ISO 12100 durchgeführt. Bei elektrischen Betriebsmitteln gibt es ein ähnliches Verfahren nach CENELEC Guide 32. Und auch die GPSR (General Product Safety Regulation / Produktsicherheitsverordnung) schreibt seit 2024 eine Risikoanalyse vor.
Die CE-CON Safety unterstützt Sie dabei bei einer strukturierten und lückenlosen Durchführung und ganz automatisch bei der Einhaltung des Drei-Stufen-Verfahrens.
Da die EN ISO 12100 als ISO-Norm weltweit anwendbar ist, ist CE-CON Safety auch für Maschinen geeignet, die außerhalb der EU in Verkehr gebracht werden.[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Vorschriften und Normen"]CE-Vorschriften, Normen und andere für die Produktsicherheit entscheidenden Informationen ändern sich fortlaufend. Aus diesem Grund wird CE-CON Safety ständig auf dem aktuellen Stand gehalten, indem die Datenbestände mehrmals im Monat auf Neuerungen geprüft und automatisch in der Software aktualisiert werden. Die Datenbank umfasst z.B. rund 9000 Datensätze für die in der EU veröffentlichten harmonisierten Normen.
Und selbstverständlich wird auch der Übergang von der Maschinenrichtlinie 2006/42/EG auf die neue Maschinenverordnung (EU) 2023/1230 vollumfänglich unterstützt.[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Compliance Manager"]Das CE-Konformitätsbewertungsverfahren besteht nicht nur aus einer Risikobeurteilung! Die CE-Vorschriften stellen noch viele weitere Anforderungen an konforme Produkte.
Im Compliance Manager finden Sie projekttypen-abhängige Prüflisten und smarte Assistenten, die für Ihr Projekt relevant sind:
 	Grundlegende Sicherheits- und Gesundheitsschutzanforderungen
 	Technische Unterlagen für Maschinen
 	Anforderungen der verschiedenen Konformitätsbewertungsmodule
 	Nachmarktpflichten
 	Informationen zur Kennzeichnung von Produkten
Mit CE-CON Safety können Sie also den kompletten CE-Prozess abdecken.[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Dreh- und Angelpunkt für die Product Compliance"]Mit CE-CON Safety haben Sie immer im Blick, ob Sie die Anforderungen für Ihr Produkt bereits vollständig erfüllt haben oder ob noch Aufgaben offen sind oder bestimmte Bereiche noch bearbeitet werden müssen.
Zudem unterstützt CE-CON Safety durch Bereitstellung selektierter Listen die Arbeit der technischen Redakteure, Konstrukteure und derjenigen, die Maßnahmen im Rahmen funktionale Sicherheit validieren müssen z.B. mit
 	Steuerungstechnischen Maßnahmen mit Performance-Level
 	Liste mit Piktogrammen, die zu verwenden sind
 	Liste mit Benutzerinformationen, zur Übernahme in die Betriebs-/Montageanleitung
Diese Prüflisten können Sie über ein mobiles Endgerät oder in Papierform direkt an dem Produkt oder der Maschine bearbeiten und als geprüft kennzeichnen.
Eigene Prüflisten können kundenspezifisch konfiguriert und für Sie hinterlegt werden.[/vc_toggle][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1744634650020{padding-top: 20px !important;}"]

Sprechen Sie uns gerne an.[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="CE-Support und fachliche Unterstützung"]CE-CON Safety ist mehr als nur eine Software. Unsere Experten entwickeln zusammen mit Ihnen die passenden Lösungen für Ihre Projekte und zeigen Ihnen auch gleich, wie Sie diese optimal in CE-CON Safety umsetzen können.
Wir helfen Ihnen, den für Ihr Unternehmen passenden CE-Prozess zu entwickeln und in der Software CE-CON Safety abzubilden.
Als Teil der TÜV Nord Group können wir Sie bei Ihren Projekten weltweit unterstützen und auf ein breites Netzwerk von Experten aus den unterschiedlichsten Fachrichtungen zurückgreifen.[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Hilfe und Software Support"]Unsere smarte Hilfefunktion in CE-CON Safety sorgt dafür, dass Sie sich an jeder Stelle in der Software die dazu passenden Hilfetexte und Erläuterungen anzeigen lassen können.

Häufig gestellte Fragen (FAQ) zur Software für Risikobeurteilung und CE-Kennzeichnung
[/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_toggle title="Was ist eine Risikobeurteilung nach EN ISO 12100?"]Eine Risikobeurteilung gemäß EN ISO 12100 ist ein strukturierter Prozess zur Identifizierung und Bewertung von Gefährdungen an Maschinen sowie zur Erstellung geeigneter Schutzmaßnahmen. CE-CON Safety hilft Ihnen dabei, Schritt für Schritt.
 	Typische Gefährdungen: mechanisch, elektrisch, thermisch
 	Resultat: Festgehaltene Maßnahmen und rechtssichere CE-Konformität
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Wie schnell spare ich mit CE-CON Safety Zeit bei der Risikobeurteilung?"]
Schon nach wenigen Projekten berichten Kunden von deutlicher Zeitersparnis, da wiederkehrende Arbeitsschritte standardisiert ablaufen.
Durchschnittlich 30–40 % weniger Aufwand bei der Dokumentation
Vorlagen und Copy-Paste entfallen durch modulare Struktur
 	Bei Serienprodukte ist der Arbeitszeitgewinn sogar bei ca. 60 %
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Welche Module bietet CE-CON Safety?"]
CE-CON Safety umfasst verschiedene Module, die je nach Bedarf einzeln oder kombiniert eingesetzt werden können:
Modul für Maschinensicherheit: Maschinenrichtlinie & Maschinenverordnung, Risikobeurteilung, Maßnahmenmanagement, CE-Konformitätserklärungen und Compliance Checklisten (Selbst testen)
Modul für Lockout-Tagout (LoTo): Sichere Wartung und Instandhaltung umsetzen, HSE-Policy und LoTo Prozeduren erstellen & Verwalten (Selbst testen)
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Für wen ist die Software CE-CON geeignet?"]
Die Software richtet sich an alle, die CE-Kennzeichnungen effizient erstellen und verwalten müssen.
Maschinenbauer & Integratoren
Betreiber und CE-Beauftragte in Unternehmen

### Features
[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" css=".vc_custom_1702389410539{background-image: url(https://www.ce-con.com/wp-content/uploads/revslider/en_functions/ce_kennzeichnung_ce_kennzeichen_2.jpg?id=8434) !important;background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}" el_id="head"][vc_column width="7/12"][/vc_column][vc_column width="5/12" css=".vc_custom_1702370291798{padding-top: 10px !important;padding-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_custom_heading text="Features" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1702389389165{padding-top: 125px !important;padding-bottom: 125px !important;padding-left: 30px !important;background-color: #ffffff !important;}"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row" css=".vc_custom_1654536991360{background-color: #eeeeee !important;}"][vc_column][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1656775804221{margin-bottom: 40px !important;}" el_class="container"]
CE-CON Safety has a lot to offer
[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1705563290739{margin-bottom: 40px !important;}" el_class="container"]Our software CE-CON Safety provides a wide range of features. Even in the trial version of CE-CON Safety you have the opportunity to access the whole range of these features in the software. Just give it a try and get your free trial now![/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column css=".vc_custom_1656762255138{margin-top: 40px !important;}"][vc_column_text]
Functional examples
[/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"]
                 RISK ASSESSMENT SYSTEM 
                  The risk assessment in CE-CON Safety is created based on the international standard ISO 12100:2010. Two different systems are currently available for the evaluation of risks. One is the tried and tested system that we adopted from the predecessor to CE-CON Safety (Clever Risk Assessment). The other is the internationally renowned and widely distributed system of Hazard Rating Numbers (HRN). You can choose which you would rather work with.
                 MEASURE TYPE 
                  We have already predefined many measure types for you and defined some useful input fields. For example, for the type ``light grid``, you will find fields for the distance to the danger area and the after-run time. This information helps you to make your risk assessment as complete as possible.
                 MULTI-USER SYSTEM 
                  CE-CON Safety enables multiple users to easily work on the same project at the same time in the system. This considerably reduces the time required for creating risk assessments and generates synergies.
                 MULTILINGUAL CAPABILITY 
                  CE-CON Safety offers a multilingual, user-friendly interface. With no extra effort, you can, for example, print your documents in multiple languages or save projects in multiple languages.
                 PRODUCT HISTORY 
                  It must be possible to track changes when products are changed. The CE software offers you a straightforward method of tracking with separation of product and project, to provide a transparent overview of your product history. You will always be able to check when and where any changes have been made.
                 STANDARDS AND OTHER REGULATIONS 
                  Standards are protected documents, and therefore we cannot provide you with content at any point. But we do keep the lists of European and harmonised standards integrated in CE-CON Safety up to date at all times. We also offer a list of data for a selection of important international (ISO) standards and other regulations (e.g. ANSI, NFPA, OSHA).
                 HELP FUNCTIONS 
                  In addition to numerous additional short help texts, which appear over the individual fields when moving the mouse, a user manual is also available online. On some pages, it is also possible to display direct help offering many helpful tips. These help texts, and also our support service, can of course be accessed from within CE-CON Safety.
		   [/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"]
                 CLOUD 
                  CE-CON Safety is a software solution that is provided over the Internet. This German Cloud solution is also described as ``software as a service``. For you, this means that you can use the software directly with no installation required. No hidden costs! You can access and use CE-CON Safety via an Internet browser wherever you are in the world. We recommend Chrome or Firefox.
                 SYSTEM MAINTENANCE 
                  Your tasks are already diverse enough. CE-CON Safety is intended to support you in your day-to-day work. You use the software - and we deal with all the maintenance and related systems. Your dashboard provides you with information when we have made any changes.
                 SYSTEM UPDATES 
                  Lists of standards, guidelines, and other important information is changing constantly. We are therefore continually working on helpful enhancements for CE-CON Safety. This service is provided free of charge! You simply receive information via your dashboard that we have installed an update, and which improvements or changes this resulted in.
                 COMPLIANCE 
                  To ensure you are working to the latest legal status, our compliance managers are continually researching for new developments. When changes are made, you are informed immediately on the dashboard, and a corresponding update is prepared.
                 TECHNOLOGY 
                  The software is developed with the use of the latest technology, and therefore offers a future-proof platform for the many enhancements that are already in development for you.
                 DATA PROTECTION AND SECURITY 
                  Security is a top priority at CE-CON. CE-CON Safety is operated in a computing centre in Bremen with an energy supply and cooling system protected by a back-up emergency diesel generator. The computing centre is redundantly connected to the fibre optic network with 24/7 monitoring. In terms of data protection and security, CE-CON guarantees that all requirements are complied with. The data saved in the software belongs to the users and is protected by encrypted access (SSL). Backups are created at regular intervals and are even stored in separate physical compartments.
		   [/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row]

What our clients say

                As managing director of this company, I have to deal with CE marking, as we as manufacturers bear the responsibility. With CE-CON we have a partner at our side who supports us in all questions concerning CE marking. From project management to documentation and certification. The satisfaction of our customers is close to our hearts and secures our future. Therefore it is our privilege to be accompanied from the initial idea to the delivery of the machines with advice and practical support. CE-CON offers us an ``all-round carefree package`` - decisive for our long-standing cooperation.
				Jörg Kruse / Kruse Metallbau GmbH
                We have a modern corporate culture. The training and further education of our employees is just as important to us as their safety and enjoyment at work. For this reason, we were looking for a partner with both the professional and social skills to accompany us in risk assessment. Our employees should return home as healthy as they were when they started work. Because the well-being and safety of our employees is close to our hearts.
				Erland SØRPEBØL / Hydro
                With the introduction of the LOTOTO process, I feel much more confident and comfortable in my role as the responsible technician for the safe maintenance of the equipment. Now, everyone involved has the knowledge, the capabilities and the equipment to bring plants and machines into a safe working condition. Even under high production pressure and during very stressful downtimes, there are no exceptions to the LOTOTO rule: Total control of all energy - One person, one key. Besides, I am very proud that even employees of external companies provide the feedback: I feel safe with your LOTOTO procedure.
				Karl Briehl / Perstorp
                As the world's leading manufacturer of arc welding and blow torches, we spot technological trends and steer courses in joining technology. We map risk assessments for CE labelling mandated by legislative bodies with CE-CON Safety. This cloud software enables us to always find the latest standards and guidelines for CE certification through automatic updates from CE-CON. We particularly appreciate being assisted by the software through the processes, automatically receiving notification when something is missing, and for instance simply being able to copy projects. Thanks to CE-CON Safety, today our risk assessment creation is highly convenient and saves us a great deal of time and money.
				Udo Kessler / Alexander Binzel Schweisstechnik GmbH & Co. KG
                As an internationally operating company, we are dependent on having a partner at our side who is familiar with the applicable standards and directives in the field of occupational and machine safety worldwide. CE-CON is exactly the partner we were looking for. The many years of experience of CE-CON's experts enable us to ensure the safety for our employees and helps us to comply with legal requirements.
				Marco Del Castillo / BOCAR Group

### Software
[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" css=".vc_custom_1719251425084{background-image: url(https://www.ce-con.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Software-21.jpg?id=10034) !important;background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}" el_id="head"][vc_column width="7/12"][/vc_column][vc_column width="5/12" css=".vc_custom_1702370291798{padding-top: 10px !important;padding-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_custom_heading text="Software
CE-CON Safety" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1702378626138{padding-top: 100px !important;padding-bottom: 100px !important;padding-left: 30px !important;background-color: #ffffff !important;}"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row" content_placement="middle" top_padding="60px" bottom_padding="60px" css=".vc_custom_1650303913826{background-color: #eeeeee !important;}"][vc_column][vc_column_text]
Powerful cloud-based software solution for fast EN ISO 12100 risk assessments that provide legal certainty
 
The conformity assessment procedure for CE marking is very complex and involves a clearly defined sequence of steps. Our CE-CON Safety software solution simplifies the procedure and provides you with optimal support on the way to your CE marking with extensive help tools and customised templates.
The CE software can be used for various types of products (e.g. machines, systems, conveyor belts, etc.). In addition, CE-CON Safety is also suitable for the declaration of conformity for global markets because the risk assessment meets the international standard. As there is no complicated installation, CE-CON Safety enables you to work on a network anywhere in the world.
Thanks to its multi-user functionality and multilingual capability, our CE software is ideal for large companies with locations at home and abroad.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_btn title="GET YOUR QUOTE" style="custom" custom_background="#96c021" custom_text="#ffffff" shape="square" align="center" link="url:https%3A%2F%2Fblog.ce-con.de%2Fanfrage"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_btn title="BOOK AN EXPERT" style="custom" custom_background="#96c021" custom_text="#ffffff" shape="square" align="center" link="url:https%3A%2F%2Fmeetings.hubspot.com%2Fpeter-rossmann%2Fce-con-safety-erstgesprach|target:_blank"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=".vc_custom_1718959611157{padding-bottom: 50px !important;}"][vc_column width="1/6"][/vc_column][vc_column width="2/3"]
Certify your products in accordance with international standard ISO 12100:2010. Access various procedures for classifying risk, such as the commonly used HRN procedure (Hazard Rating Numbers). This provides a solid basis for international business. 
							Risk assessment 
							Beurteilen Sie die Risiken Ihrer Produkte nach der internationalen
Norm ISO 12100:2010. Zur Einstufung von Risiken steht  Ihnen das weit
verbreitete HRN-Verfahren zur Verfügung.  
Demenstprechend sind Sie auch international sicher aufgestellt. 
Project administration 
							Project administration offers you a precise overview of when you’ve made changes to products. Access a detailed history of implemented modifications: Why were changes made? What exactly was changed? This can even include significant alterations where applicable. 
Technical documentation 
							Technical documentation in accordance with applicable directives in CE-CON Safety is generated at the push of a button. Assistance is also available for creating operating instructions or for validating the Performance Level. Documentation can be adapted easily to your CI.

CE-CON Safety has been simplifying CE marking since 2008!
 
With more than 20 years of experience, our customers trust us and see us as an experienced, competent partner for machine and plant safety. Our software CE-CON Safety enables you to risk-assess your products to EN ISO 12100, reduce your liability risk and save valuable time when it comes to the conformity assessment procedure.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/6"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/3"][vc_column_text]

Free introductory webinars
We hold a free familiarisation webinar on the CE-CON Safety software. The webinar gives you an overview of the various functions and tips and tricks. You’ll also get a heads up on upcoming upgrades.[/vc_column_text][vc_btn title="Register" style="custom" custom_background="#e76442" custom_text="#ffffff" shape="square" link="url:https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ce-con.de%2Fen%2Fce-software%2Ffree-webinars-ce-con-safety-for-risk-assessments%2F|title:Free%20webinars%20CE-CON%20Safety%20for%20risk%20assessments|target:_blank"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row" css=".vc_custom_1724243194950{background-color: #eeeeee !important;}" el_id="features"][vc_column css=".vc_custom_1656762255138{margin-top: 40px !important;}"][vc_column_text]
Functional examples
Our software CE-CON Safety provides a wide range of features. Even in the trial version of CE-CON Safety you have the opportunity to access the whole range of these features in the software. Just give it a try and get your free trial now!
[/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_toggle title="Risk assessment system"]
The risk assessment in CE-CON Safety is created based on the international standard ISO 12100:2010. Two different systems are currently available for the evaluation of risks. One is the tried and tested system that we adopted from the predecessor to CE-CON Safety (Clever Risk Assessment). The other is the internationally renowned and widely distributed system of Hazard Rating Numbers (HRN). You can choose which you would rather work with.
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Measure type"]
We have already predefined many measure types for you and defined some useful input fields. For example, for the type "light grid", you will find fields for the distance to the danger area and the after-run time. This information helps you to make your risk assessment as complete as possible.
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Multi-user System"]
CE-CON Safety enables multiple users to easily work on the same project at the same time in the system. This considerably reduces the time required for creating risk assessments and generates synergies.
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Multilingual capability"]
CE-CON Safety offers a multilingual, user-friendly interface. With no extra effort, you can, for example, print your documents in multiple languages or save projects in multiple languages.
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Product history"]
It must be possible to track changes when products are changed. The CE software offers you a straightforward method of tracking with separation of product and project, to provide a transparent overview of your product history. You will always be able to check when and where any changes have been made.
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Standards and other regulations"]
Standards are protected documents, and therefore we cannot provide you with content at any point. But we do keep the lists of European and harmonised standards integrated in CE-CON Safety up to date at all times. We also offer a list of data for a selection of important international (ISO) standards and other regulations (e.g. ANSI, NFPA, OSHA).
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Help functions"]
In addition to numerous additional short help texts, which appear over the individual fields when moving the mouse, a user manual is also available online. On some pages, it is also possible to display direct help offering many helpful tips. These help texts, and also our support service, can of course be accessed from within CE-CON Safety.
[/vc_toggle][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_toggle title="Cloud"]
CE-CON Safety is a software solution that is provided over the Internet. This German Cloud solution is also described as ``software as a service``. For you, this means that you can use the software directly with no installation required. No hidden costs! You can access and use CE-CON Safety via an Internet browser wherever you are in the world. We recommend Chrome or Firefox.
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="System maintenance"]
Your tasks are already diverse enough. CE-CON Safety is intended to support you in your day-to-day work. You use the software - and we deal with all the maintenance and related systems. Your dashboard provides you with information when we have made any changes.
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="System updates"]
Lists of standards, guidelines, and other important information is changing constantly. We are therefore continually working on helpful enhancements for CE-CON Safety. This service is provided free of charge! You simply receive information via your dashboard that we have installed an update, and which improvements or changes this resulted in.
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Compliance"]
To ensure you are working to the latest legal status, our compliance managers are continually researching for new developments. When changes are made, you are informed immediately on the dashboard, and a corresponding update is prepared.
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Technology"]
The software is developed with the use of the latest technology, and therefore offers a future-proof platform for the many enhancements that are already in development for you.
[/vc_toggle][vc_toggle title="Data protection and security"]
Security is a top priority at CE-CON. CE-CON Safety is operated in a computing centre in Bremen with an energy supply and cooling system protected by a back-up emergency diesel generator. The computing centre is redundantly connected to the fibre optic network with 24/7 monitoring. In terms of data protection and security, CE-CON guarantees that all requirements are complied with. The data saved in the software belongs to the users and is protected by encrypted access (SSL). Backups are created at regular intervals and are even stored in separate physical compartments.
[/vc_toggle][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row" top_padding="40px" bottom_padding="0px" css=".vc_custom_1745564613010{background-color: #ffffff !important;}" el_id="use-cases"][vc_column][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1656769303545{margin-bottom: 0px !important;}"]

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]Occupational safety includes all measures that aim to ensure the safety and health of all employees in their workplace. It entails the identification, assessment, and minimisation of hazards and risks that may occur in the workplace. Occupational safety also includes the compliance with laws and regulations, employee training, supply of protection equipment, and the implementation of safety measures in a company. The overall goal is to avoid or minimise work related injuries, occupational diseases, and other occupational health risks.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_section][vc_row css=".vc_custom_1713858514613{padding-top: 30px !important;padding-bottom: 30px !important;}"][vc_column width="2/12"][/vc_column][vc_column width="3/12"][vc_btn title="CONTACT US" style="custom" custom_background="#96c021" custom_text="#ffffff" shape="square" align="center" button_block="true" link="url:https%3A%2F%2Fblog.ce-con.de%2Finquiry-general|target:_blank"][vc_column_text]

What our clients say
[/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner]
                As managing director of this company, I have to deal with CE marking, as we as manufacturers bear the responsibility. With CE-CON we have a partner at our side who supports us in all questions concerning CE marking. From project management to documentation and certification. The satisfaction of our customers is close to our hearts and secures our future. Therefore it is our privilege to be accompanied from the initial idea to the delivery of the machines with advice and practical support. CE-CON offers us an ``all-round carefree package`` - decisive for our long-standing cooperation.
				Jörg Kruse / Kruse Metallbau GmbH
                We have a modern corporate culture. The training and further education of our employees is just as important to us as their safety and enjoyment at work. For this reason, we were looking for a partner with both the professional and social skills to accompany us in risk assessment. Our employees should return home as healthy as they were when they started work. Because the well-being and safety of our employees is close to our hearts.
				Erland SØRPEBØL / Hydro
                With the introduction of the LOTOTO process, I feel much more confident and comfortable in my role as the responsible technician for the safe maintenance of the equipment. Now, everyone involved has the knowledge, the capabilities and the equipment to bring plants and machines into a safe working condition. Even under high production pressure and during very stressful downtimes, there are no exceptions to the LOTOTO rule: Total control of all energy - One person, one key. Besides, I am very proud that even employees of external companies provide the feedback: I feel safe with your LOTOTO procedure.
				Karl Briehl / Perstorp
                As the world's leading manufacturer of arc welding and blow torches, we spot technological trends and steer courses in joining technology. We map risk assessments for CE labelling mandated by legislative bodies with CE-CON Safety. This cloud software enables us to always find the latest standards and guidelines for CE certification through automatic updates from CE-CON. We particularly appreciate being assisted by the software through the processes, automatically receiving notification when something is missing, and for instance simply being able to copy projects. Thanks to CE-CON Safety, today our risk assessment creation is highly convenient and saves us a great deal of time and money.
				Udo Kessler / Alexander Binzel Schweisstechnik GmbH & Co. KG
                As an internationally operating company, we are dependent on having a partner at our side who is familiar with the applicable standards and directives in the field of occupational and machine safety worldwide. CE-CON is exactly the partner we were looking for. The many years of experience of CE-CON's experts enable us to ensure the safety for our employees and helps us to comply with legal requirements.
				Marco Del Castillo / BOCAR Group

Privacy Policy
We, the CE-CON GmbH, Lloydstraße 4-6, 28217 Bremen, Tel. +49 821 567 280-16, www.ce-con.de, are the operators of this website and the services offered to it. We are therefore responsible for the collection, processing and use of personal data according to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Telemediengesetz (TMG) when you visit our website.
We use your personal data in compliance with the applicable data protection regulations. With this privacy policy, we will inform you of the personal data collected and stored by you when you visit our website or use our services offered through the website. You will also receive information on how your data is used and what rights you are entitled to with regard to the use of your data.
1. Responsible Body
Responsible body for the collection, processing and use of their personal data in terms of the DSGVO is the data protection officer of CE-CON GmbH:
datenschutz@ce-con.de
If you wish to object to the collection, processing or use of your data by us in accordance with this Privacy Policy as a whole or for individual measures, you can address your objection to the above-mentioned responsible body.
You can save and print this privacy policy at any time.
2. Collection and storage of personal data and the nature and purpose of their use
a. When visiting our site
You can visit our website at www.ce-con.de without disclosing your identity. Your browser automatically sends information to the server of our website. This information is temporarily stored in a log file. The following information will be collected without your intervention and stored up to the automated deletion after 6 months at the latest:
• IP address of the requesting computer,
• Date and time of access,
• the name and URL of the retrieved file,
• Web site from which to access (referrer URL),
• the browser used and the operating system of your computer as well as the name of your access provider.
The legal basis for the collection and processing of this data is Article 6 (1) (f) GDPR. It is for the purpose of facilitating the use of our website (connection establishment), ensuring system security and stability, and technical administration of the network infrastructure. We do not draw any conclusions about you as a person.
The gathering and processing of this data takes place for the purpose of facilitating the use of our website (connection set-up), ensuring the system security and stability, as well as the technical administration of the network infrastructure. We do not draw conclusions about you as a person.
We also use cookies, analysis and marketing services when visiting our website. Please refer to section 4 of this privacy policy and our cookie policy for further details.
b. When registering for our shop
Through our website, we offer various performance packages within the scope of CE-CON Safety, CE-CON Academy and CE-CON Consulting. The service packages are offered through our integrated online shop and cover the use of cloud-based software applications, training and consulting services. If you wish to purchase one of our service packages, an online registration is required. In addition to a valid e-mail address and the choice of a password as a personal access data, you must provide the following information during the registration process:
• First name and surname
• company
• Street, house number
• ZIP / City
• country
In addition, you can enter additional information about yourself (eg VAT ID, telephone, fax) as well as a different delivery address.
We use this information,
• to know who our contractual partner is;
• to provide you with explanations about the use, use and application of our software application;
• to check the entered data for plausibility as well as
• contact you if necessary.
Depending on the type of payment selected by you, payment data (for example, bank details for SEBA direct debit) are to be specified.
The legal basis of data processing is Article 6 (1) (b) GDPR.
c. When registering for our free offers
You can access a number of free offers through our website. This includes a test access to CE-CON Safety, various webinars and whitepaper.
In order to be able to access these free offers, a registration is required. In the course of the application, the following mandatory information is requested:
• Salutation, first name, surname
• E-mail address
• Companies
We use this information,
• to set up a customer account for the test access, or
• to enable you to participate in a webinar (submission link submissions) or
• to send you the link to a whitepaper by e-mail
as
• to know who is claiming our services and
• for the prosecution of abuses.
The legal basis of the survey is Article 6 (1) (a), (f) GDPR.Your logon data will be deleted as soon as they are no longer required.
d. When requesting an offer
You have the opportunity to request a quote about our services through our website. As part of the requirement, you must state your first and last name, your e-mail address and your company. You can voluntarily provide further information on the contact, your industry and the desired product offer.
We will use this information to get in touch with you and provide you with an offer tailored to your needs. The legal basis of the survey is Article 6 (1) (a), (b), (f) GDPR.
e. Sign up for our newsletter
If you have consented, we use your e-mail address to send you our newsletter regularly. An e-mail address is sufficient to receive the newsletter. You are free to provide your name and address so that we can address you personally. The legal basis of the survey is Article 6 (1) (a), (f) GDPR.
Logging out is possible at any time, e.g. via a link at the end of each newsletter. Alternatively, you can send your subscription request by e-mail to datenschutz@ce-con.de at any time.
We also use cookies, analysis and marketing services. Please refer to section 4 of this privacy policy and our cookie policy for further details.
f. When using our contact form
You can send general inquiries to us via the contact form provided on our website. A valid e-mail address is mandatory. Further information may be voluntary.
The collection of this data takes place in order to have knowledge, from whom a request originates and in order to answer it. The legal basis of the survey is Article 6 (1) (a), (f) GDPR.
g. When using the Software CE-CON Safety
If you have purchased access to our software CE-CON Safety, you can register at https://safety.ce-con.de.
Here you can give information about projects, products, components, danger zones, hazards, life phases and measures within the software. This data will not be processed.
In order to improve the software CE-CON Safety, the following information will be collected without your intervention and stored until the automated deletion after 6 months at the latest:

• date and time of access,
• name and URL of the retrieved file,
• Web site of access (referrer URL),
• the browser used and the operating system of your computer as well as the name of your access provider,
• and in exceptional cases the username.
We also use cookies, analysis and marketing services when visiting our website. Please refer to section 4 of this privacy policy and our cookie policy for further details.
The legal basis of the survey are our obligations under the contractual relationship pursuant to Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR and our legitimate interest in constantly improving the CE-CON Safety software from Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR.
3. Transfer of data
As far as this is legally permissible and necessary for the handling of contractual relations with you, your personal data will be passed on to third parties. This includes in particular the transfer to payment service providers or credit institutions in order to carry out a payment procedure. The data passed on may be used by the third party solely for the purpose of its distribution.
In addition, we only transfer your personal data to third parties if you have expressly consented, or to the extent that there is a legal obligation or as long as the transmission is necessary for the enforcement of proven legal claims of third parties and there is no reason to believe that you have a predominant interest worthy of protection non-transfer of your data.
No transfer of your personal data to third parties for other purposes will take place.
4. Cookies
We use cookies on our site. These are small files that your browser automatically creates and which are stored on your device (laptop, tablet, smartphone, etc.) when you visit our site. Cookies do not damage your device, do not contain viruses, Trojans or other malicious software.
In the cookie, information is stored, which in each case results in connection with the specifically used terminal. However, this does not mean that we are immediately aware of your identity.
The use of cookies serves to make the use of our offer more pleasant for you. This is how we use so-called session cookies to recognize that you have already visited individual pages of our website, already registered in your customer account or to the shopping basket. These are automatically deleted after leaving our site.
In addition, we also use temporary cookies that are stored on your device for a certain period of time to optimize usability. Visit our site again to use our services, it is automatically recognized that you were already with us and what inputs and settings they have made, so you do not have to enter them again.
On the other hand, we use cookies to statistically record the use of our website and to evaluate it for you in order to optimize our offer (see cookie policy). These cookies allow us to automatically recognize when you visit our site that you were already with us. These cookies are automatically deleted after a defined time.
Most browsers accept cookies automatically. However, you can configure your browser so that no cookies are stored on your computer or a message appears before a new cookie is created.
However, the complete deactivation of cookies may result in you not being able to use all the features of our website.
5. Analysis tools and advertising
Google Analytics
This website uses functions of the web analysis service Google Analytics. The provider of this service is Google Ireland Limited (“Google”), Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland.
Google Analytics enables the website operator to analyze the behavior patterns of website visitors. To that end, the website operator receives a variety of user data, such as pages accessed, time spent on the page, the utilized operating system and the user’s origin. This data is assigned to the respective end device of the user. An assignment to a user-ID does not take place.
Furthermore, Google Analytics allows us to record your mouse and scroll movements and clicks, among other things. Google Analytics uses various modeling approaches to augment the collected data sets and uses machine learning technologies in data analysis.
Google Analytics uses technologies that make the recognition of the user for the purpose of analyzing the user behavior patterns (e.g., cookies or device fingerprinting). The website use information recorded by Google is, as a rule transferred to a Google server in the United States, where it is stored.
The use of these services occurs on the basis of your consent pursuant to Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR and § 25(1) TTDSG. You may revoke your consent at any time.
Data transmission to the US is based on the Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) of the European Commission. Details can be found here: https://privacy.google.com/businesses/controllerterms/mccs/.
The company is certified in accordance with the “EU-US Data Privacy Framework” (DPF). The DPF is an agreement between the European Union and the US, which is intended to ensure compliance with European data protection standards for data processing in the US. Every company certified under the DPF is obliged to comply with these data protection standards. For more information, please contact the provider under the following link: https://www.dataprivacyframework.gov/s/participant-search/participant-detail?contact=true&id=a2zt000000001L5AAI&status=Active
Browser plug-in

Contract data processing

6. Site-Search
A search box on our website will be provided for you. The search function allows you to search specifically for content on our site. The search queries can be statistically evaluated by us to optimize our site offer. In this context, pseudonyms can be created. This does not mean that we will receive personal data. Please do not use the search function if you do not want us to collect and evaluate your search queries on our website.
7. Data Security
All data transmitted by you is encrypted with the generally accepted and secure TLS (Transport Layer Security) standard. TLS is a safe and proven standard, which includes e.g. is also used in online banking. You can recognize a secure TLS connection, eg, at the attached s at http (ie https: // ..) in the address bar of your browser or at the lock icon at the bottom of your browser.
The servers used for our website are located in computer centers and are connected to the Internet via a complex system architecture. Incoming and outgoing data traffic is routed through routers, load balancers, switches, etc., which each allow a certain maximum data throughput rate. There is no direct connection of individual servers to transfer points to the Internet. The data centers are located within the EU.
We also use appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your data against accidental or intentional manipulation, partial or complete loss, destruction or against the unauthorized access of third parties. Our security measures are continuously improved in line with technological developments.
8. Information, correction, blocking and deletion
You have a right of information regarding the personal data you have stored about us and a right to correct incorrect data as well as a right to block or delete it.
For information about your personal data, for the correction of incorrect data or for blocking or deleting it, as well as for further questions about the use of your personal data, please send us an e-mail to datenschutz@ce-con.de. We would like to point out that in the case of the blocking or deletion of your data, utilization of our offer is no longer possible or is no longer possible in its entirety.

9. Up-to-dateness and modification of this data protection statement

### UKCA Marking
[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" css=".vc_custom_1702374257318{background-image: url(https://www.ce-con.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/CE-Software_Kennzeichnung_Leistungsangebot_Software_sec5_1.jpg?id=2077) !important;background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}" el_id="head"][vc_column width="7/12"][/vc_column][vc_column width="5/12" css=".vc_custom_1702370291798{padding-top: 10px !important;padding-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_custom_heading text="UKCA-
Marking" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1723549925309{padding-top: 100px !important;padding-bottom: 100px !important;padding-left: 30px !important;background-color: #ffffff !important;}"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row" css=".vc_custom_1613396972863{padding-top: 40px !important;padding-bottom: 20px !important;background-color: #eeeeee !important;}"][vc_column][vc_column_text]
UKCA - Product Compliance in the United Kingdom
[/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_single_image image="7813" img_size="medium" add_caption="yes"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="3/4"][vc_column_text]The UKCA marking (UK Conformity Assessed) is the new label for products in the United Kingdom. The UKCA marking can be seen as a counterpart to the CE label. Both the UKCA marking and the CE label have product safety as their basic idea and are based on specific regulations and standards.
As specialists in product compliance, we know that the topic can seem very obscure. Therefore, we are happy to support you and review your documents or take over the entire product compliance and marking for you![/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=".vc_custom_1613396943956{padding-top: 40px !important;padding-bottom: 20px !important;}"][vc_column][vc_column_text]
How can we support you with UKCA marking?
[/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"]
            Export to the EU
            UK --> EU
            Document retention in the EUAuthorized personReview of the declaration of conformityConsulting on CE marking
		  [/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"]
            Document check UKCA
            EU --> UK
            Review of your existing documentsReview of your designated standardsClear recommendations for actionDirect contact person
		  [/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"]
            Full Service UKCA marking
            EU --> UK
            Individual consulting for your productComplete compilation of documentsUp-to-date legally compliant basicsFull service for you
		  [/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row" css=".vc_custom_1613396959616{padding-top: 40px !important;padding-bottom: 20px !important;background-color: #eeeeee !important;}"][vc_column][vc_column_text]
FAQ – Frequently asked questions about the UKCA labeling
[/vc_column_text][vc_tta_accordion][vc_tta_section title="Who must issue the UKCA mark?" tab_id="1613732925138-b162a4bf-a39a"][vc_column_text]The UKCA mark may only be affixed to your product by you as the manufacturer or your authorized representative (if provided for in the relevant legislation). By affixing the mark and
signing the Declaration of Conformity, you assume all responsibility and liability for the product.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Is the UKCA label required for my product?" tab_id="1613732925176-9976fbc8-99c3"][vc_column_text]This is to be checked in the relevant legislation. A large number of products are required to carry the UKCA marking, but there are also products for which there is no specific directive, in which case no UKCA marking may be applied.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Where should the UKCA marking be placed?" tab_id="1613733031653-0a979edb-c8d0"][vc_column_text]For most products, the UKCA marking must be placed directly on the product or on the packaging. In some cases, it may also be placed on other accompanying documentation. Again, this depends on specific regulations that apply to the product.
However, as of January 1st, 2023, it must be placed on the product.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Do I need an authorized representative in the EU?" tab_id="1613733047490-8ce184f9-0f86"][vc_column_text]Both the European and the UK Conformity Assessment require documents to be retained. The documents must be made available at all times to the relevant market surveillance and enforcement authority. As of July 16th, 2021, you must be able to name an authorized representative based in the EU or EEA for the respective distribution in these markets.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="When does the UKCA label start to apply?" tab_id="1613733078357-8a487248-47ba"][vc_column_text]As of January 1st, 2021, Great Britain is no longer part of the EU and the UKCA label replaces the CE label. Until January 1st, 2022 a transitional arrangement is still in place, which is reserved for certain products. From January 1st, 2022, on, the UKCA label must be affixed at the latest.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][/vc_column][/vc_row]

### Cookie-Policy
[vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]
Cookie-Policy
1. Introduction
Our website, https://www.ce-con.com (hereinafter: "The Website") uses cookies and similar technologies (for convenience, all of these are collectively referred to as "cookies"). Cookies are also placed by third parties contracted by us. In the document below we inform you about the use of cookies on our website.
 2. What are cookies?
A cookie is a simple small file that can be sent with the pages of an internet address and stored by the web browser on the PC or other device. The information stored in it may be sent to our or relevant third party servers during subsequent visits.
3. What are scripts?
A script is a piece of program code used to provide functionality and interactivity to our website. This code is executed on our servers or on your device.
4. What is a web beacon?
A web beacon (also called a pixel tag) is a small invisible text fragment or image on a website that is used to monitor traffic on the website. To make this possible, various data about you is stored using web beacons.
5. Cookies
5.1 Technical or functional cookies
Some cookies ensure that parts of our website function properly and that your user preferences remain known. By placing functional cookies, we make it easier for you to visit our website. This way, when you visit our website, you don't have to repeatedly enter the same information, or your items remain in your shopping cart until you pay, for example. We may place these cookies without your consent.
5.2 Statistics cookies
We use statistics cookies to optimise the website experience for our users. These statistics cookies provide us with insights into the use of our website. We ask for your permission to set statistics cookies.
5.3 Advertising cookies
On this website we use advertising cookies to gain insight into campaign results. This is done based on a profile that we create based on your behaviour in https://www.ce-con.com. These cookies link you as a website visitor to a unique ID. However, these cookies do not profile your behaviour and interests in order to serve personalised ads.
5.4 Marketing- / Tracking-Cookies

### Cookie-Policy

Cookie-Policy
1. Introduction
Our website, https://www.ce-con.com (hereinafter: "The Website") uses cookies and similar technologies (for convenience, all of these are collectively referred to as "cookies"). Cookies are also placed by third parties contracted by us. In the document below we inform you about the use of cookies on our website.
 2. What are cookies?
A cookie is a simple small file that can be sent with the pages of an internet address and stored by the web browser on the PC or other device. The information stored in it may be sent to our or relevant third party servers during subsequent visits.
3. What are scripts?
A script is a piece of program code used to provide functionality and interactivity to our website. This code is executed on our servers or on your device.
4. What is a web beacon?
A web beacon (also called a pixel tag) is a small invisible text fragment or image on a website that is used to monitor traffic on the website. To make this possible, various data about you is stored using web beacons.
5. Cookies
5.1 Technical or functional cookies
Some cookies ensure that parts of our website function properly and that your user preferences remain known. By placing functional cookies, we make it easier for you to visit our website. This way, when you visit our website, you don't have to repeatedly enter the same information, or your items remain in your shopping cart until you pay, for example. We may place these cookies without your consent.
5.2 Statistics cookies
We use statistics cookies to optimise the website experience for our users. These statistics cookies provide us with insights into the use of our website. We ask for your permission to set statistics cookies.
5.3 Advertising cookies
On this website we use advertising cookies to gain insight into campaign results. This is done based on a profile that we create based on your behaviour in https://www.ce-con.com. These cookies link you as a website visitor to a unique ID. However, these cookies do not profile your behaviour and interests in order to serve personalised ads.
5.4 Marketing- / Tracking-Cookies
Marketing / tracking cookies are cookies or other form of local storage used to create user profiles to display advertisements or track the user on this website or across multiple websites for similar marketing purposes.
As these cookies are marked as tracking cookies, we require your consent to place them.
5.5 Social media

### UKCA Marking
[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" css=".vc_custom_1702374257318{background-image: url(https://www.ce-con.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/CE-Software_Kennzeichnung_Leistungsangebot_Software_sec5_1.jpg?id=2077) !important;background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}" el_id="head"][vc_column width="7/12"][/vc_column][vc_column width="5/12" css=".vc_custom_1702370291798{padding-top: 10px !important;padding-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_custom_heading text="UKCA-
