UKCA - Product Compliance in the United Kingdom
[/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_single_image image="7813" img_size="medium" add_caption="yes"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="3/4"][vc_column_text]The UKCA marking (UK Conformity Assessed) is the new label for products in the United Kingdom. The UKCA marking can be seen as a counterpart to the CE label. Both the UKCA marking and the CE label have product safety as their basic idea and are based on specific regulations and standards.
As specialists in product compliance, we know that the topic can seem very obscure. Therefore, we are happy to support you and review your documents or take over the entire product compliance and marking for you![/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=".vc_custom_1613396943956{padding-top: 40px !important;padding-bottom: 20px !important;}"][vc_column][vc_column_text]

FAQ – Frequently asked questions about the UKCA labeling
[/vc_column_text][vc_tta_accordion][vc_tta_section title="Who must issue the UKCA mark?" tab_id="1613732925138-b162a4bf-a39a"][vc_column_text]The UKCA mark may only be affixed to your product by you as the manufacturer or your authorized representative (if provided for in the relevant legislation). By affixing the mark and
signing the Declaration of Conformity, you assume all responsibility and liability for the product.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Is the UKCA label required for my product?" tab_id="1613732925176-9976fbc8-99c3"][vc_column_text]This is to be checked in the relevant legislation. A large number of products are required to carry the UKCA marking, but there are also products for which there is no specific directive, in which case no UKCA marking may be applied.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Where should the UKCA marking be placed?" tab_id="1613733031653-0a979edb-c8d0"][vc_column_text]For most products, the UKCA marking must be placed directly on the product or on the packaging. In some cases, it may also be placed on other accompanying documentation. Again, this depends on specific regulations that apply to the product.
However, as of January 1st, 2023, it must be placed on the product.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Do I need an authorized representative in the EU?" tab_id="1613733047490-8ce184f9-0f86"][vc_column_text]Both the European and the UK Conformity Assessment require documents to be retained. The documents must be made available at all times to the relevant market surveillance and enforcement authority. As of July 16th, 2021, you must be able to name an authorized representative based in the EU or EEA for the respective distribution in these markets.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="When does the UKCA label start to apply?" tab_id="1613733078357-8a487248-47ba"][vc_column_text]As of January 1st, 2021, Great Britain is no longer part of the EU and the UKCA label replaces the CE label. Until January 1st, 2022 a transitional arrangement is still in place, which is reserved for certain products. From January 1st, 2022, on, the UKCA label must be affixed at the latest.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/vc_tta_accordion][/vc_column][/vc_row]

We, the CE-CON GmbH, Lloydstraße 4-6, 28217 Bremen, Tel. +49 821 567 280-16, www.ce-con.de, are the operators of this website and the services offered to it. We are therefore responsible for the collection, processing and use of personal data according to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Telemediengesetz (TMG) when you visit our website.
We use your personal data in compliance with the applicable data protection regulations. With this privacy policy, we will inform you of the personal data collected and stored by you when you visit our website or use our services offered through the website. You will also receive information on how your data is used and what rights you are entitled to with regard to the use of your data.
1. Responsible Body
Responsible body for the collection, processing and use of their personal data in terms of the DSGVO is the data protection officer of CE-CON GmbH:
datenschutz@ce-con.de
If you wish to object to the collection, processing or use of your data by us in accordance with this Privacy Policy as a whole or for individual measures, you can address your objection to the above-mentioned responsible body.
You can save and print this privacy policy at any time.
2. Collection and storage of personal data and the nature and purpose of their use
a. When visiting our site
You can visit our website at www.ce-con.de without disclosing your identity. Your browser automatically sends information to the server of our website. This information is temporarily stored in a log file. The following information will be collected without your intervention and stored up to the automated deletion after 6 months at the latest:
• IP address of the requesting computer,
• Date and time of access,
• the name and URL of the retrieved file,
• Web site from which to access (referrer URL),
• the browser used and the operating system of your computer as well as the name of your access provider.
The legal basis for the collection and processing of this data is Article 6 (1) (f) GDPR. It is for the purpose of facilitating the use of our website (connection establishment), ensuring system security and stability, and technical administration of the network infrastructure. We do not draw any conclusions about you as a person.
The gathering and processing of this data takes place for the purpose of facilitating the use of our website (connection set-up), ensuring the system security and stability, as well as the technical administration of the network infrastructure. We do not draw conclusions about you as a person.
We also use cookies, analysis and marketing services when visiting our website. Please refer to section 4 of this privacy policy and our cookie policy for further details.
b. When registering for our shop
Through our website, we offer various performance packages within the scope of CE-CON Safety, CE-CON Academy and CE-CON Consulting. The service packages are offered through our integrated online shop and cover the use of cloud-based software applications, training and consulting services. If you wish to purchase one of our service packages, an online registration is required. In addition to a valid e-mail address and the choice of a password as a personal access data, you must provide the following information during the registration process:
• First name and surname
• company
• Street, house number
• ZIP / City
• country
In addition, you can enter additional information about yourself (eg VAT ID, telephone, fax) as well as a different delivery address.

4. Cookies
We use cookies on our site. These are small files that your browser automatically creates and which are stored on your device (laptop, tablet, smartphone, etc.) when you visit our site. Cookies do not damage your device, do not contain viruses, Trojans or other malicious software.
In the cookie, information is stored, which in each case results in connection with the specifically used terminal. However, this does not mean that we are immediately aware of your identity.
The use of cookies serves to make the use of our offer more pleasant for you. This is how we use so-called session cookies to recognize that you have already visited individual pages of our website, already registered in your customer account or to the shopping basket. These are automatically deleted after leaving our site.
In addition, we also use temporary cookies that are stored on your device for a certain period of time to optimize usability. Visit our site again to use our services, it is automatically recognized that you were already with us and what inputs and settings they have made, so you do not have to enter them again.
On the other hand, we use cookies to statistically record the use of our website and to evaluate it for you in order to optimize our offer (see cookie policy). These cookies allow us to automatically recognize when you visit our site that you were already with us. These cookies are automatically deleted after a defined time.
Most browsers accept cookies automatically. However, you can configure your browser so that no cookies are stored on your computer or a message appears before a new cookie is created.
However, the complete deactivation of cookies may result in you not being able to use all the features of our website.

### Technical Documentation
[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" css=".vc_custom_1720522897679{background-image: url(https://www.ce-con.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/Technische-Dokumentation.jpg?id=10118) !important;background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}" el_id="head"][vc_column width="7/12"][/vc_column][vc_column width="5/12" css=".vc_custom_1702370291798{padding-top: 10px !important;padding-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_custom_heading text="Technical
Documentation" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1702380247980{padding-top: 100px !important;padding-bottom: 100px !important;padding-left: 30px !important;background-color: #ffffff !important;}"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row" css=".vc_custom_1561628204621{background-color: #eeeeee !important;}"][vc_column][vc_row_inner css=".vc_custom_1561628322003{padding-top: 40px !important;}"][vc_column_inner width="1/6"][vc_single_image image="3712" img_size="full"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/6"][vc_column_text]
What is considered Technical Documentation?
To prevent slowing down market placement due to an an incomplete manual, we offer our support with technical documentation. Here we distinguish between two kinds:
 
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]
Internal technical documentation
Internal documentation covers a collection of all schematics, technical drawings, test protocols, functional specification documents, calculations, verification of quality assurance and results of risk assessment. Simply all documents of a product/machine over its complete life cycle. These documents remain with the manufacturer and must be available on request.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]
External technical documentation
External documentation contains all information issued to the customer, such as instruction manuals, assembly instructions, warnings and safety data sheets. The information must be adjusted to the target group and to the surrounding circumstances. Next to guidelines from valid directives, standards and country-specific exceptions also play a big role in the creation of external documentations.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=".vc_custom_1559291190280{margin-top: 40px !important;}"][vc_column][vc_column_text]
Our services regarding Technical Documentation
[/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner content_placement="middle" css=".vc_custom_1560246647604{margin-bottom: 10px !important;border-bottom-width: 10px !important;padding-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_column_inner width="1/6"][vc_icon icon_fontawesome="fa fa-pencil-square-o" color="custom" size="xl" align="center" custom_color="#ee7953"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/6"][vc_column_text]
Examination of existing documentations
You already have existing manuals, but are not sure about their completeness? In that case we can conduct a documentation check and examine the critical parts step by step. We thereby not only look at the compliance of standards but also at the design and structure of the texts, for even a wrong font size or an incomplete warning could lead to personal damage in the worst case. Upon request we can also check if your texts are written translation-oriented or if there is potential for optimization to save translation costs.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner content_placement="middle" css=".vc_custom_1560246665828{margin-bottom: 10px !important;border-bottom-width: 10px !important;padding-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_column_inner width="1/6"][vc_icon icon_fontawesome="fa fa-user-circle-o" color="custom" size="xl" align="center" custom_color="#ee7953"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/6"][vc_column_text]
Training of employees
And if you plan on creating your external documentation yourself, we can get you there safely with seminars and inhouse trainings. Together we can work through rules of formulation, requirements and structure of chapters. Additionally we can check if modern means, such as content management systems or interactive technical documentations on mobile devices, are attractive and appropriate for your company. Let your staff be prepared by experienced technical editors for your technical documentation.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner content_placement="middle" css=".vc_custom_1560246614774{margin-bottom: 20px !important;border-bottom-width: 20px !important;padding-bottom: 20px !important;}"][vc_column_inner width="1/6"][vc_icon icon_fontawesome="fa fa-file-text-o" color="custom" size="xl" align="center" custom_color="#ee7953"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/6"][vc_column_text]
Creating instruction manuals
We can create a standard-compliant instruction manual for you, with consideration of the latest state of technology, such as DIN EN 82079 or ANSI Z535. We hereby conduct research on your site or, for smaller projects, conduct research interviews on the phone with your contact partners. Based on designs, valid standards, documentation of supply and the risk assessments we will create manuals valid for the whole life cycle.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row]

[/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_single_image image="4725"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="3/4"][vc_column_text]Risk assessment is the targeted examination of products. Risk assessment for machinery
We are happy to support you in the preparation of legally compliant risk assessments for machines in accordance with the Machinery Directive. This is done with the use of EN ISO 12100:2010. Performance Level Calculation
The EN ISO 13849-1 standard describes the procedure for quantifying hazards and determining the performance level (PLr) for safety functions. The second part of the EN ISO 13849 standard specifies how the performance level required is calculated and validated in the risk assessment for each control measure.

### LoTo - Lock out Tag out
[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" css=".vc_custom_1720534452206{background-image: url(https://www.ce-con.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/Logout-Tagout.jpg?id=10112) !important;background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}" el_id="head"][vc_column width="7/12"][/vc_column][vc_column width="5/12" css=".vc_custom_1702370291798{padding-top: 10px !important;padding-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_custom_heading text="Lockout/Tagout" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1720534429151{padding-top: 100px !important;padding-bottom: 100px !important;padding-left: 30px !important;background-color: #ffffff !important;}"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row" content_placement="middle" top_padding="60px" bottom_padding="60px" css=".vc_custom_1561714388038{background-color: #eeeeee !important;}"][vc_column css=".vc_custom_1481021841949{padding-top: 20px !important;padding-bottom: 20px !important;}"][vc_row_inner content_placement="bottom"][vc_column_inner width="1/6"][vc_single_image image="1635" img_size="full"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/6"][vc_column_text]
Lock Out Tag Out - LoTo procedures to increase the safety of your employees
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner el_class="container"][vc_column_inner width="1/2" css=".vc_custom_1481034688278{padding-right: 20px !important;}"][vc_column_text]Constructing machines to be safe is an obligation. Procedures for safe maintenance, repairs, servicing and cleaning are discretionary. LoTo stands for Lock Out – Tag Out.
In essence, a machine remains potentially dangerous even when shut down. For instance, if a user starts the machine up while the machine is being maintained, a potentially life-threatening situation can arise. To prevent this, a machine can be rendered powerless using the LoTo procedure to ensure no further risk of movement. This ensures the safety of your maintenance and repair personnel at all times.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]Does your machine have a lockable main electrical switch? Excellent! But what about pressure accumulators in hydraulic and pneumatic systems? What about kinetic energy? Are acids, alkalis or other hazardous substances present in your machine? Is there a risk of explosion or risk of chemical reactions such as if cleaning with the wrong tool?
To ensure all hazards are excluded and all necessary work on systems can be performed safely, LoTo procedures can be very useful. Furthermore, these procedures also provide much needed assistance in the form of training documentation for instructing new staff members.
Are you unfamiliar with LoTo procedures? We would be happy to assist you or to take care of creating LoTo procedures for you.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=".vc_custom_1561714415039{padding-top: 40px !important;}"][vc_column][vc_column_text]
Our services regarding LoTo (Lock out - Tag out)
[/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_single_image image="1568" img_size="full"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="3/4"][vc_column_text]The topic LoTo is very extensive. Therefore we offer you versatile support in this area:
 	Development of a LoTo procedure tailored to your needs
 	Examination of your machines, plants and production processes
 	Development of LoTo procedures related to plants
 	Marking of the switch-off points
 	Introduction of the method and procedures
 	Training of your employees
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row" bottom_padding="60px" css=".vc_custom_1561712396528{padding-top: 40px !important;background-color: #eeeeee !important;}"][vc_column][vc_column_text]
Your advantages with CE-CON
[/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_single_image image="1569" img_size="full"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="3/4"][vc_column_text]Although there presently remains no statutory obligation to introduce the LoTo procedure, it is nevertheless beneficial in fulfilling the statutory requirements of the German Ordinance on Industrial Safety and Health (BetrSichV).
US standard 21 CFR 1910.147 of the OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) provides a pragmatic approach in this respect. We too follow this standard. From the development of an overall strategy to the training of your staff, we are on side to assist you. A 3-stage plan, comprising analysis, development and introduction of LoTo, has proven a best practice.
CE-CON addresses your requirements and is with you every step of the way.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=".vc_custom_1561714675143{padding-top: 40px !important;}"][vc_column][vc_column_text]

[/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner content_placement="middle"][vc_column_inner width="1/6"][vc_single_image image="2108" img_size="full"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/6"][vc_column_text]Training: 
Certified LoTo Expert[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="3/6"][vc_column_text]During the three-day training course, you will learn what basic procedures and authorities need to be taken care of. These are laid down in a so-called LoTo Policy, which then applies to the entire procedure.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/6"][vc_btn title="Further information" style="custom" custom_background="#96c021" custom_text="#ffffff" shape="square" link="url:https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ce-con.com%2Fen%2Facademy%2Fcertified-loto-expert%2F"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row]

### LoTo - Lock out Tag out
[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" css=".vc_custom_1720534452206{background-image: url(https://www.ce-con.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/Logout-Tagout.jpg?id=10112) !important;background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}" el_id="head"][vc_column width="7/12"][/vc_column][vc_column width="5/12" css=".vc_custom_1702370291798{padding-top: 10px !important;padding-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_custom_heading text="Lockout/Tagout" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1720534429151{padding-top: 100px !important;padding-bottom: 100px !important;padding-left: 30px !important;background-color: #ffffff !important;}"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row" content_placement="middle" top_padding="60px" bottom_padding="60px" css=".vc_custom_1561714388038{background-color: #eeeeee !important;}"][vc_column css=".vc_custom_1481021841949{padding-top: 20px !important;padding-bottom: 20px !important;}"][vc_row_inner content_placement="bottom"][vc_column_inner width="1/6"][vc_single_image image="1635" img_size="full"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/6"][vc_column_text]
Lock Out Tag Out - LoTo procedures to increase the safety of your employees
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner el_class="container"][vc_column_inner width="1/2" css=".vc_custom_1481034688278{padding-right: 20px !important;}"][vc_column_text]Constructing machines to be safe is an obligation. Procedures for safe maintenance, repairs, servicing and cleaning are discretionary. LoTo stands for Lock Out – Tag Out.
In essence, a machine remains potentially dangerous even when shut down. For instance, if a user starts the machine up while the machine is being maintained, a potentially life-threatening situation can arise. To prevent this, a machine can be rendered powerless using the LoTo procedure to ensure no further risk of movement. This ensures the safety of your maintenance and repair personnel at all times.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]Does your machine have a lockable main electrical switch? Excellent! But what about pressure accumulators in hydraulic and pneumatic systems? What about kinetic energy? Are acids, alkalis or other hazardous substances present in your machine? Is there a risk of explosion or risk of chemical reactions such as if cleaning with the wrong tool?
To ensure all hazards are excluded and all necessary work on systems can be performed safely, LoTo procedures can be very useful. Furthermore, these procedures also provide much needed assistance in the form of training documentation for instructing new staff members.
Are you unfamiliar with LoTo procedures? We would be happy to assist you or to take care of creating LoTo procedures for you.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=".vc_custom_1561714415039{padding-top: 40px !important;}"][vc_column][vc_column_text]
Our services regarding LoTo (Lock out - Tag out)
[/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_single_image image="1568" img_size="full"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="3/4"][vc_column_text]The topic LoTo is very extensive. Therefore we offer you versatile support in this area:
 	Development of a LoTo procedure tailored to your needs
 	Examination of your machines, plants and production processes
 	Development of LoTo procedures related to plants
 	Marking of the switch-off points
 	Introduction of the method and procedures
 	Training of your employees
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row" bottom_padding="60px" css=".vc_custom_1561712396528{padding-top: 40px !important;background-color: #eeeeee !important;}"][vc_column][vc_column_text]

US standard 21 CFR 1910.147 of the OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) provides a pragmatic approach in this respect. We too follow this standard. From the development of an overall strategy to the training of your staff, we are on side to assist you. A 3-stage plan, comprising analysis, development and introduction of LoTo, has proven a best practice.

### Risk Assessment
[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" css=".vc_custom_1720534285979{background-image: url(https://www.ce-con.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/Risikobeurteilung.jpg?id=10114) !important;background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}" el_id="head"][vc_column width="7/12"][/vc_column][vc_column width="5/12" css=".vc_custom_1702370291798{padding-top: 10px !important;padding-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_custom_heading text="Machinery risk

The aim is to identify hazards and possible degrees of injuries. The identified hazards result in measures that should adequately minimize the risk.
Mr. Handwerk, Managing Director of CE-CON GmbH, provides us with a small foretaste on the subject of risk assessment. From the risk of an individual to the manufacturers of products. Risk assessment for machinery
We are happy to support you in the preparation of legally compliant risk assessments for machines in accordance with the Machinery Directive. This is done with the use of EN ISO 12100:2010. We identify danger points, determine the resulting risk and then show you possible risk mitigation measures.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_single_image image="1392" img_size="medium"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="3/4"][vc_column_text]
Performance Level Calculation
The EN ISO 13849-1 standard describes the procedure for quantifying hazards and determining the performance level (PLr) for safety functions. The second part of the EN ISO 13849 standard specifies how the performance level required is calculated and validated in the risk assessment for each control measure.
We will be happy to advise you on everything from component selection to the creation of circuit diagrams for your pneumatic, hydraulic and electrical control components and safety functions.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row" css=".vc_custom_1564397465513{padding-top: 40px !important;background-color: #eeeeee !important;}"][vc_column][vc_column_text]

### Technical Documentation
[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" css=".vc_custom_1720522897679{background-image: url(https://www.ce-con.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/Technische-Dokumentation.jpg?id=10118) !important;background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}" el_id="head"][vc_column width="7/12"][/vc_column][vc_column width="5/12" css=".vc_custom_1702370291798{padding-top: 10px !important;padding-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_custom_heading text="Technical
Documentation" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1702380247980{padding-top: 100px !important;padding-bottom: 100px !important;padding-left: 30px !important;background-color: #ffffff !important;}"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row" css=".vc_custom_1561628204621{background-color: #eeeeee !important;}"][vc_column][vc_row_inner css=".vc_custom_1561628322003{padding-top: 40px !important;}"][vc_column_inner width="1/6"][vc_single_image image="3712" img_size="full"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/6"][vc_column_text]
What is considered Technical Documentation?
To prevent slowing down market placement due to an an incomplete manual, we offer our support with technical documentation. Here we distinguish between two kinds:
 
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]
Internal technical documentation
Internal documentation covers a collection of all schematics, technical drawings, test protocols, functional specification documents, calculations, verification of quality assurance and results of risk assessment. Simply all documents of a product/machine over its complete life cycle. These documents remain with the manufacturer and must be available on request.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]
External technical documentation
External documentation contains all information issued to the customer, such as instruction manuals, assembly instructions, warnings and safety data sheets. The information must be adjusted to the target group and to the surrounding circumstances. Next to guidelines from valid directives, standards and country-specific exceptions also play a big role in the creation of external documentations.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=".vc_custom_1559291190280{margin-top: 40px !important;}"][vc_column][vc_column_text]
Our services regarding Technical Documentation
[/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner content_placement="middle" css=".vc_custom_1560246647604{margin-bottom: 10px !important;border-bottom-width: 10px !important;padding-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_column_inner width="1/6"][vc_icon icon_fontawesome="fa fa-pencil-square-o" color="custom" size="xl" align="center" custom_color="#ee7953"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/6"][vc_column_text]
Examination of existing documentations
You already have existing manuals, but are not sure about their completeness? In that case we can conduct a documentation check and examine the critical parts step by step. We thereby not only look at the compliance of standards but also at the design and structure of the texts, for even a wrong font size or an incomplete warning could lead to personal damage in the worst case. Upon request we can also check if your texts are written translation-oriented or if there is potential for optimization to save translation costs.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner content_placement="middle" css=".vc_custom_1560246665828{margin-bottom: 10px !important;border-bottom-width: 10px !important;padding-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_column_inner width="1/6"][vc_icon icon_fontawesome="fa fa-user-circle-o" color="custom" size="xl" align="center" custom_color="#ee7953"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/6"][vc_column_text]
Training of employees
And if you plan on creating your external documentation yourself, we can get you there safely with seminars and inhouse trainings. Together we can work through rules of formulation, requirements and structure of chapters. Additionally we can check if modern means, such as content management systems or interactive technical documentations on mobile devices, are attractive and appropriate for your company. Let your staff be prepared by experienced technical editors for your technical documentation.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner content_placement="middle" css=".vc_custom_1560246614774{margin-bottom: 20px !important;border-bottom-width: 20px !important;padding-bottom: 20px !important;}"][vc_column_inner width="1/6"][vc_icon icon_fontawesome="fa fa-file-text-o" color="custom" size="xl" align="center" custom_color="#ee7953"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="5/6"][vc_column_text]
Creating instruction manuals
We can create a standard-compliant instruction manual for you, with consideration of the latest state of technology, such as DIN EN 82079 or ANSI Z535. We hereby conduct research on your site or, for smaller projects, conduct research interviews on the phone with your contact partners. Based on designs, valid standards, documentation of supply and the risk assessments we will create manuals valid for the whole life cycle.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row]

### Technical safety assessment
[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" css=".vc_custom_1720596530237{background-image: url(https://www.ce-con.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/Sicherheitstechnische-Beurteilung.jpg?id=10116) !important;background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}" el_id="head"][vc_column width="7/12"][/vc_column][vc_column width="5/12" css=".vc_custom_1702370291798{padding-top: 10px !important;padding-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_custom_heading text="Technical safety

Operator or manufacturer? - Technical safety assessment on either side
[/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_single_image image="1563" img_size="full"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="3/4"][vc_column_text]A targeted technical safety assessment allows us as an independent service provider to determine whether the condition of your machinery delivers a maximum degree of protection for your staff and thus satisfies applicable laws or whether subsequent improvements are necessary.

We help you to pre-emptively define interfaces or to create safety concepts and thus to avoid unnecessary discussions with your clients, to reduce costs and to strengthen your position![/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner css=".vc_custom_1485530824077{padding-top: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="container"][vc_column_inner width="1/2" css=".vc_custom_1481034688278{padding-right: 20px !important;}"][vc_column_text]
Maschine operator
By carrying out a technical safety assessment, you as the machine operator comply with the legal obligation to protect employees from hazards arising from machines and work equipment.
No matter whether it is a single, separately installed machine or an interlinked machine. You can obtain concrete information on what can be done to enable your employees to work safely and without risk in guidelines, standards and laws.

Maschine manufacturer
As a manufacturer, a technical safety assessment can be applied in various scenarios. For example, if you modify / extend machines or have the order to replace a plant that is already linked to other machines. In either case, the first question to be clarified is whether this is a " substantial modification" and whether your machine safety is therefore impaired.
An analysis of the existing machines is absolutely necessary. In this way, it is possible to define the interfaces and adjoining plants in order to specify a tailored safety concept for your scope of supply.
This often involves maintaining an existing CE marking or issuing a new one. This applies to all interlinked plants that are outside your scope of supply but are connected to your machine via an interface.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bottom_padding="60px"][vc_column][vc_column_text]

### International Conformity
[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" css=".vc_custom_1720534564164{background-image: url(https://www.ce-con.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/Internationale-Konformitaet.jpg?id=10110) !important;background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}" el_id="head"][vc_column width="7/12"][/vc_column][vc_column width="5/12" css=".vc_custom_1702370291798{padding-top: 10px !important;padding-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_custom_heading text="International
Conformity" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1702380006767{padding-top: 100px !important;padding-bottom: 100px !important;padding-left: 30px !important;background-color: #ffffff !important;}"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row" css=".vc_custom_1560424341289{padding-top: 60px !important;background-color: #eeeeee !important;}"][vc_column width="1/4"][vc_single_image image="6624" img_size="full"][/vc_column][vc_column width="3/4"][vc_column_text]
International conformity - the US market has its own unique rules
The EC Declaration of Conformity is based on the applicable European law. If a company moves outside the EU, it is important to review directives on international conformity. Essential differences quickly become apparent, for example by examining the US market.
Caution is advised before placing your products on the US market. The regulations that apply in the USA are not the same as those in Europe.  Nevertheless, it is imperative that both the operator and the manufacturer comply with the applicable regulations on occupational safety and machine safety abroad. We know that it is not easy to be familiar with all applicable standards and directives. That is why we support you in all aspects of safe commissioning or provision of machines on the US market.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text]The OSHA - Occupational Safety and Health Administration - is the authority responsible for occupational safety in most states of the USA. The OSHA 29 CFR 1910 (Occupational Safety and Health Standards) set by the OSHA define the applicable directives for occupational safety in the USA. Their standards determine the conformity of machinery on the US market.
According to OSHA, some product types require some form of certification to comply with the standards defined by OSHA. This certification is performed by the Nationally Recognized Testing Laboratory (NRTL). A machine is only safe if it has passed the test performed by a verified NRTL and received the appropriate test mark.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row" css=".vc_custom_1561029342865{padding-top: 60px !important;}"][vc_column][vc_column_text]
UKCA marking for Great Britain
[/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_single_image image="6619" img_size="full"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="3/4"][vc_column_text]After Brexit, the CE mark will also lose its validity in Great Britain. It will be succeeded by the UKCA mark (UK Conformity Assessed). It can be seen as a counterpart to the CE mark. Both markings indicate product safety. However, some of the requirements for the UKCA marking are different from those for the CE marking. It is therefore worth taking a closer look at the marking if goods or products are to be traded between the UK and the EU.
As specialists in product compliance, we know that the topic can seem very opaque, so we are happy to support you and check your documents or take over the entire product testing and labeling for you![/vc_column_text][vc_btn title="More information about UKCA marking" style="custom" custom_background="#181a52" custom_text="#ffffff" size="lg" align="center" link="url:https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ce-con.com%2Fen%2Fconsulting%2Fukca-marking%2F"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row]

### HSE - Occupational Safety
[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" css=".vc_custom_1720534529481{background-image: url(https://www.ce-con.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/HSE-Unterseite.jpg?id=10108) !important;background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}" el_id="head"][vc_column width="7/12"][/vc_column][vc_column width="5/12" css=".vc_custom_1702370291798{padding-top: 10px !important;padding-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_custom_heading text="Health Safety
Environment" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1702379649474{padding-top: 100px !important;padding-bottom: 100px !important;padding-left: 30px !important;background-color: #ffffff !important;}"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row" top_padding="60px" bottom_padding="60px" css=".vc_custom_1560240879898{background-color: #eeeeee !important;}"][vc_column width="1/2" css=".vc_custom_1481021841949{padding-top: 20px !important;padding-bottom: 20px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1561627600896{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 0px !important;}"]
HSE - Operational safety in all sectors
For industrial companies in particular, it is becoming increasingly important to adhere to requirements governing protection of health and the environment and occupational safety.
In the ideal case, occupational safety goes hand in hand with machine safety. Both have the goal of preventing accidents and ensuring a safe working environment. It is self-evident that it is not always easy to connect both sides.
For this reason, we provide expert assistance in the planning, implementation, controlling and optimization of operational processes in the areas of health protection, occupational safety and environmental management.

Our services regarding health safety environment
[/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner content_placement="middle" el_class="container"][vc_column_inner width="1/6"][vc_single_image image="1570" img_size="full"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="3/6"][vc_column_text]
Technical Safety assessment
Employers are obligated to ensure that no hazards can be posed by working equipment. A technical safety assessment shows whether a machine technically complies with necessary requirements.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/6"][vc_btn title="about Technical safety assessment" style="custom" custom_background="#96c021" custom_text="#ffffff" shape="square" link="url:https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ce-con.com%2Fen%2Fconsulting%2Fhse%2Ftechnical-safety-assessment%2F"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner content_placement="middle" el_class="container"][vc_column_inner width="1/6" css=".vc_custom_1481034688278{padding-right: 20px !important;}"][vc_single_image image="3712" img_size="full"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="3/6"][vc_column_text]
Hazard assessment
Hazard assessment is regarded as a modern instrument for occupational safety. Compared to conventional accident prevention, it also takes operational concerns into account.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/6"][vc_btn title="about Hazard assessment" style="custom" custom_background="#96c021" custom_text="#ffffff" shape="square" link="url:https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ce-con.com%2Fen%2Fconsulting%2Fhse%2Fhazard-assessment%2F"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner content_placement="middle"][vc_column_inner width="1/6"][vc_single_image image="1568" img_size="full"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="3/6"][vc_column_text]
LoTo
Lock Out Tag Out – LoTo for short – originates in the US and refers to the safe shutting off of all power sources posing a risk. It involves reactivation blocks, e.g. when performing maintenance work on machines.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/6"][vc_btn title="about LoTo" style="custom" custom_background="#96c021" custom_text="#ffffff" shape="square" link="url:https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ce-con.com%2Fen%2Fconsulting%2Floto%2F"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row" top_padding="60px" bottom_padding="60px" css=".vc_custom_1560241577597{background-color: #eeeeee !important;}"][vc_column css=".vc_custom_1481021841949{padding-top: 20px !important;padding-bottom: 20px !important;}"][vc_column_text]

### Hazard assessment
[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" css=".vc_custom_1702379783930{background-image: url(https://www.ce-con.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/ce_kennzeichnung_maschinenrichtlinie-1-e1576151760574.jpg?id=6424) !important;background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}" el_id="head"][vc_column width="7/12"][/vc_column][vc_column width="5/12" css=".vc_custom_1702370291798{padding-top: 10px !important;padding-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_custom_heading text="Hazard
assessment" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1702379757425{padding-top: 100px !important;padding-bottom: 100px !important;padding-left: 30px !important;background-color: #ffffff !important;}"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" content_placement="middle" top_padding="60px" bottom_padding="60px" css=".vc_custom_1481720602267{margin-bottom: 60px !important;background-color: #eeeeee !important;}"][vc_column css=".vc_custom_1481021841949{padding-top: 20px !important;padding-bottom: 20px !important;}"][vc_column_text el_class="container" css=".vc_custom_1561639354653{padding-bottom: 0px !important;}"]
Hazard assessment according to the German ordinances on Industrial Safety and Health (BetrSichV) and Hazardous Substances (GefStoffV)
[/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner el_class="container" css=".vc_custom_1481729163285{padding-top: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 0px !important;}"][vc_column_inner width="1/2" css=".vc_custom_1481034688278{padding-right: 20px !important;}"][vc_column_text]Hazard assessment for occupational safety - Modern occupational safety and health aims to prevent health hazards and enhance workplace well-being. Employers assume responsibility in this regard for their staff, as safety in the workplace is considered one of the major objectives to be followed in any company. After all, every employee wants to return home healthy in the evening.
Hazard assessment, which unlike conventional accident prevention, also considers operational concerns, is available as a modern tool in occupational safety and health. The need to examine operational-specific concerns has been recognised by legislative bodies for some time now and hazard assessment consequently is taken into account in the German Occupational Safety and Health Act and in the German Ordinance on Industrial Safety and Health and Ordinance on Hazardous Substances. It is therefore obligatory for employers.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]In Germany, the provision of operating equipment by employers and the use of operating equipment by employees is regulated in the German Ordinance on Industrial Safety and Health (BetrSichV) “Ordinance governing safety and health protection for the use of operating equipment”.
Interaction with hazardous substances in operational environments is regulated in parallel by the German Ordinance on Hazardous Substances (GefStoffV) “Ordinance on protection against hazardous substances. Both regulations are valid in an amended form as of 01 June 2015.
Further information on the topic of hazard assessment in the age of Industry 4.0 is also available in our free white paper.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]

We work together with you to develop a host of different measures. We implement these not just through the attainment of protection targets, but by safeguarding the danger areas identified through hazard assessment using the latest methods and technologies. We produce the necessary documentation as mandated by the German Ordinance on Industrial Safety and Health (BetrSichV) and
Ordinance on Hazardous Substances (GefStoffV) and show you how to permanently reduce hazards and thereby lower your liability and operating costs.

### Technical safety assessment
[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" css=".vc_custom_1720596530237{background-image: url(https://www.ce-con.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/Sicherheitstechnische-Beurteilung.jpg?id=10116) !important;background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}" el_id="head"][vc_column width="7/12"][/vc_column][vc_column width="5/12" css=".vc_custom_1702370291798{padding-top: 10px !important;padding-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_custom_heading text="Technical safety
assessment" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1702379827698{padding-top: 100px !important;padding-bottom: 100px !important;padding-left: 30px !important;background-color: #ffffff !important;}"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row" content_placement="middle" top_padding="60px" bottom_padding="60px" css=".vc_custom_1561636716046{margin-bottom: 60px !important;background-color: #eeeeee !important;}"][vc_column css=".vc_custom_1481021841949{padding-top: 20px !important;padding-bottom: 20px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1561636666780{padding-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="container"]
Operator or manufacturer? - Technical safety assessment on either side
[/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_single_image image="1563" img_size="full"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="3/4"][vc_column_text]A targeted technical safety assessment allows us as an independent service provider to determine whether the condition of your machinery delivers a maximum degree of protection for your staff and thus satisfies applicable laws or whether subsequent improvements are necessary.
Furthermore, we protect you from legal ramifications. We help you to pre-emptively define interfaces or to create safety concepts and thus to avoid unnecessary discussions with your clients, to reduce costs and to strengthen your position![/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner css=".vc_custom_1485530824077{padding-top: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 0px !important;}" el_class="container"][vc_column_inner width="1/2" css=".vc_custom_1481034688278{padding-right: 20px !important;}"][vc_column_text]
Maschine operator
By carrying out a technical safety assessment, you as the machine operator comply with the legal obligation to protect employees from hazards arising from machines and work equipment.
No matter whether it is a single, separately installed machine or an interlinked machine. You can obtain concrete information on what can be done to enable your employees to work safely and without risk in guidelines, standards and laws.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][vc_column_text]
Maschine manufacturer
As a manufacturer, a technical safety assessment can be applied in various scenarios. For example, if you modify / extend machines or have the order to replace a plant that is already linked to other machines. In either case, the first question to be clarified is whether this is a " substantial modification" and whether your machine safety is therefore impaired.
An analysis of the existing machines is absolutely necessary. In this way, it is possible to define the interfaces and adjoining plants in order to specify a tailored safety concept for your scope of supply.
This often involves maintaining an existing CE marking or issuing a new one. This applies to all interlinked plants that are outside your scope of supply but are connected to your machine via an interface.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bottom_padding="60px"][vc_column][vc_column_text]

### International Conformity
[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" css=".vc_custom_1720534564164{background-image: url(https://www.ce-con.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/Internationale-Konformitaet.jpg?id=10110) !important;background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}" el_id="head"][vc_column width="7/12"][/vc_column][vc_column width="5/12" css=".vc_custom_1702370291798{padding-top: 10px !important;padding-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_custom_heading text="International
Conformity" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1702380006767{padding-top: 100px !important;padding-bottom: 100px !important;padding-left: 30px !important;background-color: #ffffff !important;}"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row" css=".vc_custom_1560424341289{padding-top: 60px !important;background-color: #eeeeee !important;}"][vc_column width="1/4"][vc_single_image image="6624" img_size="full"][/vc_column][vc_column width="3/4"][vc_column_text]
International conformity - the US market has its own unique rules
The EC Declaration of Conformity is based on the applicable European law. If a company moves outside the EU, it is important to review directives on international conformity. Essential differences quickly become apparent, for example by examining the US market.
Caution is advised before placing your products on the US market. The regulations that apply in the USA are not the same as those in Europe.  Nevertheless, it is imperative that both the operator and the manufacturer comply with the applicable regulations on occupational safety and machine safety abroad. We know that it is not easy to be familiar with all applicable standards and directives. That is why we support you in all aspects of safe commissioning or provision of machines on the US market.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text]The OSHA - Occupational Safety and Health Administration - is the authority responsible for occupational safety in most states of the USA. The OSHA 29 CFR 1910 (Occupational Safety and Health Standards) set by the OSHA define the applicable directives for occupational safety in the USA. Their standards determine the conformity of machinery on the US market.
According to OSHA, some product types require some form of certification to comply with the standards defined by OSHA. This certification is performed by the Nationally Recognized Testing Laboratory (NRTL). A machine is only safe if it has passed the test performed by a verified NRTL and received the appropriate test mark.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row" css=".vc_custom_1561029342865{padding-top: 60px !important;}"][vc_column][vc_column_text]
UKCA marking for Great Britain
[/vc_column_text][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_single_image image="6619" img_size="full"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="3/4"][vc_column_text]After Brexit, the CE mark will also lose its validity in Great Britain. It will be succeeded by the UKCA mark (UK Conformity Assessed). It can be seen as a counterpart to the CE mark. Both markings indicate product safety. However, some of the requirements for the UKCA marking are different from those for the CE marking. It is therefore worth taking a closer look at the marking if goods or products are to be traded between the UK and the EU.
As specialists in product compliance, we know that the topic can seem very opaque, so we are happy to support you and check your documents or take over the entire product testing and labeling for you![/vc_column_text][vc_btn title="More information about UKCA marking" style="custom" custom_background="#181a52" custom_text="#ffffff" size="lg" align="center" link="url:https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ce-con.com%2Fen%2Fconsulting%2Fukca-marking%2F"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row]

### HSE - Occupational Safety
[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content" css=".vc_custom_1720534529481{background-image: url(https://www.ce-con.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/HSE-Unterseite.jpg?id=10108) !important;background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}" el_id="head"][vc_column width="7/12"][/vc_column][vc_column width="5/12" css=".vc_custom_1702370291798{padding-top: 10px !important;padding-bottom: 10px !important;}"][vc_custom_heading text="Health Safety
Environment" font_container="tag:h1|text_align:left" use_theme_fonts="yes" css=".vc_custom_1702379649474{padding-top: 100px !important;padding-bottom: 100px !important;padding-left: 30px !important;background-color: #ffffff !important;}"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row" top_padding="60px" bottom_padding="60px" css=".vc_custom_1560240879898{background-color: #eeeeee !important;}"][vc_column width="1/2" css=".vc_custom_1481021841949{padding-top: 20px !important;padding-bottom: 20px !important;}"][vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_1561627600896{margin-bottom: 0px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 0px !important;}"]
HSE - Operational safety in all sectors
For industrial companies in particular, it is becoming increasingly important to adhere to requirements governing protection of health and the environment and occupational safety.
In the ideal case, occupational safety goes hand in hand with machine safety. Both have the goal of preventing accidents and ensuring a safe working environment. It is self-evident that it is not always easy to connect both sides.
For this reason, we provide expert assistance in the planning, implementation, controlling and optimization of operational processes in the areas of health protection, occupational safety and environmental management.

Our services regarding health safety environment

Technical Safety assessment
Employers are obligated to ensure that no hazards can be posed by working equipment. A technical safety assessment shows whether a machine technically complies with necessary requirements.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/6"][vc_btn title="about Technical safety assessment" style="custom" custom_background="#96c021" custom_text="#ffffff" shape="square" link="url:https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ce-con.com%2Fen%2Fconsulting%2Fhse%2Ftechnical-safety-assessment%2F"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner content_placement="middle" el_class="container"][vc_column_inner width="1/6" css=".vc_custom_1481034688278{padding-right: 20px !important;}"][vc_single_image image="3712" img_size="full"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="3/6"][vc_column_text]
Hazard assessment
Hazard assessment is regarded as a modern instrument for occupational safety. Compared to conventional accident prevention, it also takes operational concerns into account.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="2/6"][vc_btn title="about Hazard assessment" style="custom" custom_background="#96c021" custom_text="#ffffff" shape="square" link="url:https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ce-con.com%2Fen%2Fconsulting%2Fhse%2Fhazard-assessment%2F"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner content_placement="middle"][vc_column_inner width="1/6"][vc_single_image image="1568" img_size="full"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="3/6"][vc_column_text]
LoTo
Lock Out Tag Out – LoTo for short – originates in the US and refers to the safe shutting off of all power sources posing a risk. It involves reactivation blocks, e.g. when performing maintenance work on machines.
